title: Credit analyst/ parabroker
description:
About Echo Capital Consulting



Echo Capital Consulting is an Australian finance broking business based in Brisbane, Queensland. We handle residential home loans, commercial and development finance, and specialist lending (alt doc and non-bank). That includes a niche area of restructuring ATO tax debt against property. Many of our files are complex, involving self-employed clients, trusts, companies and short deadlines in many cases. 



We’re looking for a sharp, detail-focused Credit Analyst / Parabroker to work directly with our lead broker and take ownership of loan files from factfind through to settlement.



What You’ll Do



Review client documents (payslips, tax returns, financial statements, BAS, bank statements, ATO portals) and flag anything missing or concerning

Run bank statement analysis to identify income, living expenses, liabilities and conduct issues

Complete servicing calculations and lender comparisons using tools like Quickli

Help prepare loan structures and policy checks across major and non-bank lenders (e.g. Resimac, Pepper Money, Liberty, Macquarie)

Prepare and lodge loan applications through ApplyOnline (AOL) and keep the CRM up to date

Write credit submission notes and deal summaries for lenders and BDMs

Track applications from submission to approval, valuation, loan docs and settlement, and follow up with lenders, solicitors, accountants and clients

Order property reports and valuations (CoreLogic) and manage DocuSign workflows

Keep compliance documents in order (factfinds, credit guides, preliminary assessments)



What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)



At least 2 years’ experience as a Loan Processor, Credit Analyst or Parabroker for an Australian mortgage broker

A working understanding of Australian lending: LVR, DTI, HEM, servicing, LMI, alt doc / low doc, and how non-bank lenders differ from the major banks

Hands-on experience with ApplyOnline (AOL) and at least one broker CRM preferably mercury.

Confident reading financial statements, tax returns and BAS for self-employed borrowers

Excellent written English, since you’ll be writing lender notes and
ing clients directly

Very high attention to detail, able to manage several files at once without things slipping

A reliable laptop, a stable internet connection, a backup power/internet option, and a quiet workspace



Nice to Have



Experience with commercial, SMSF, development or construction finance

Experience with tax debt, credit-impaired or specialist lending files

Familiarity with Quickli, CoreLogic, DocuSign and Xero

Knowledge of NCCP / responsible lending obligations

Experience with business lending 



What We Offer



Long-term, stable full-time role with a growing Australian business

Direct work with the business owner, with no layers of management

Exposure to complex, interesting deals that will build your skills fast

Performance-based pay reviews [and/or bonuses, if you plan to offer them]

[Paid public holidays / leave, if applicable]



How to Apply



Please send:



Your CV

A short cover letter describing your Australian mortgage experience: which lenders, CRMs and loan types you’ve worked on

A one-paragraph answer: “A self-employed client has 2 years of tax returns showing declining income, but strong recent BAS. How would you approach the servicing assessment?”

title: SME credit analyst
description:
About Echo Capital Consulting



Echo Capital Consulting is an Australian finance broking business based in Brisbane, Queensland. Alongside home loans and commercial property finance, we help small and medium businesses get fast, flexible funding: unsecured business loans, lines of credit, cash flow finance, equipment finance and short-term working capital.



We’re looking for an SME Credit Analyst who understands Australian business lending and can turn a pile of bank statements and financials into a clean, approvable deal, fast.



What You’ll Do



Assess SME funding applications, from sole traders to established companies

Run bank statement analysis covering turnover, average monthly deposits, daily balances, dishonours, existing debt repayments and any stacking of other lenders

Review BAS, ATO portals, financial statements and aged receivables/payables to gauge cash flow and serviceability

Match each deal to the right lender and product based on time in business, turnover, credit file, industry and urgency

Prepare and submit applications to lenders such as Prospa, Moula, Plenti, Wisr, Bizcap, OnDeck, Lumi, Shift, Capify, Banjo and Judo, plus invoice and equipment finance providers

Use bank statement aggregators (e.g. illion/Bank Statements, Basiq, open banking links) to pull client data

Write clear deal summaries and credit notes for lender BDMs

Chase outstanding documents, negotiate conditions and track deals from submission to settlement

Keep the CRM and the deal pipeline accurate and up to date

Help build pricing comparisons (factor rates, interest rates, fees, total repayable) so clients understand the true cost of each option



What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)



At least 2 years’ experience in Australian SME, business or asset finance, as an analyst, processor or broker support

Direct experience submitting deals to fintech/non-bank business lenders (Prospa, Moula, Bizcap, OnDeck, Plenti or similar)

Strong bank statement analysis skills: you can spot red flags such as cash flow gaps, frequent dishonours, undisclosed lenders or ATO arrears

Understanding of key SME lending concepts: factor rates vs interest rates, daily/weekly repayments, unsecured vs secured, caveats and director guarantees, PPSR, ABN/GST registration and ATO debt

Comfortable reading BAS, P&Ls and balance sheets

Excellent written English and confidence dealing directly with business owners and lender BDMs

Able to work quickly. Speed matters a lot in cash flow lending, and many of our clients need funds within 24–72 hours

A reliable laptop, a stable internet connection, a backup power/internet option, and a quiet workspace



Nice to Have



Experience with invoice finance, trade finance or equipment/asset finance

Experience with businesses that have ATO debt or impaired credit

Familiarity with credit reporting (Equifax, illion, Experian) and ASIC company searches

Experience with Xero or MYOB reports

Some exposure to Australian residential or commercial property lending



What We Offer



Long-term, stable full-time role with a growing Australian business

Direct work with the business owner, with no layers of management

High deal volume and variety, so you’ll learn fast

Performance-based pay reviews [and/or a per-settlement bonus, if you plan to offer one]

[Paid public holidays / leave, if applicable]



How to Apply



Please send:



Your CV

A short cover letter listing the Australian business lenders you’ve submitted deals to, and your typical monthly deal volume

title: Accounting Assistant
description:
About the Role

The Accounting Assistant manages Consilium Labs’ day-to-day financial operations, ensuring accurate

financial records, timely invoicing and collections, disciplined expense management, reliable reporting,

and effective financial controls. The role supports leadership with clear financial visibility while helping

protect profitability, cash flow, and operational discipline.



Duties & Responsibilities

1. Bank Management & Payments

● Manage and monitor company bank accounts, including daily balances, transactions, transfers,

and account activity.

● Review and process approved vendor, employee, tax, and other company payments in

accordance with established approval procedures.

● Schedule and coordinate payments to ensure obligations are paid accurately and on time.

● Maintain visibility into upcoming payment obligations and available cash balances to support

short-term cash-flow planning.

● Prepare payment requests and ensure appropriate approvals and supporting documentation are

obtained before payments are processed.

● Maintain payment records, bank confirmations, remittance information, and other supporting

documentation.

● Monitor recurring payments and upcoming obligations and escalate potential cash-flow concerns

or payment issues to leadership.

● Coordinate with banks and payment providers regarding account maintenance, transaction

issues, access, and required documentation.

● Investigate unusual or unauthorized transactions and promptly escalate material issues.



2. Billing & Accounts Receivable

● Prepare and issue accurate client invoices on time based on approved contracts, billing

schedules, and supporting information.

● Assist with billing setup for new contracts and maintain accurate billing information in relevant

systems.

● Monitor accounts-receivable aging reports and follow up professionally on overdue balances.

● Maintain accurate payment records, remittance tracking, and collection documentation.

● Maintain accurate accounts-receivable aging and promptly investigate billing or payment

discrepancies.

● Alert leadership to significant collection risks or overdue balances.



3. Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

● Review vendor invoices, payment approvals, vendor files, and payment history for accuracy and

completeness.

● Process and schedule vendor payments only after required approvals have been obtained.

● Maintain accurate accounts-payable aging and visibility into upcoming vendor obligations.

● Support vendor onboarding and maintain accurate vendor records and payment information.

● Ensure expenses are properly coded, documented, and recorded in the accounting system.

● Investigate discrepancies between invoices, payment records, and accounting records.



4. Accounting & Reconciliations

● Maintain accurate and complete accounting records and supporting documentation.

● Perform monthly bank, credit-card, and balance-sheet reconciliations.

● Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies in a timely manner.

● Maintain consistency and data integrity across accounting, invoicing, payment, and related

billing systems.

● Support a timely and accurate month-end close process.

● Ensure transactions are properly classified and recorded in accordance with company accounting

procedures.



5. Payroll & Employee-Related Accounting

● Coordinate the financial processing of payroll with payroll providers based on employee and

payroll changes provided and approved by the appropriate parties.

● Maintain commission schedules, bonus tracking, reimbursement logs, and year-end payroll

documentation based on approved inputs from department owners and management.

● Ensure payroll-related accounting entries and supporting documentation are accurate and

complete.



6. Financial Reporting & Cash Flow

● Prepare monthly management reports covering revenue, expenses, margins, collections, and

cash balances.

● Support budget-versus-actual reporting and investigate significant variances.

● Maintain visibility into expected cash inflows, upcoming payment obligations, and short-term

cash-flow requirements.

● Provide management with timely financial information and escalate material cash-flow,

overspending, margin, collection, or other financial risks.

● Identify unusual transactions or financial trends that require management attention.



7. Month-End, Tax & External Support

● Support the month-end close by ensuring required transactions, reconciliations, and supporting

schedules are completed accurately and on time.

● Maintain organized records for audits, tax filings, insurance requirements, regulatory requests,

and other financial documentation.

● Support external CPAs, tax preparers, auditors, and other financial advisors by providing

requested records and information.

● Assist with year-end accounting and tax-related documentation as required.



8. Finance Systems, Processes & Controls

● Maintain accurate and consistent information across accounting, invoicing, banking, payment,

and related financial systems.

● Assist with billing setup, vendor onboarding, and payment-system administration.

● Identify opportunities to improve finance workflows, controls, processes, and automation.

● Support implementation and maintenance of procedures designed to improve accuracy,

efficiency, and visibility.

● Promptly investigate and resolve discrepancies between financial systems and source

documentation.



9. Risk Management & Confidentiality

● Maintain strict confidentiality of financial, payroll, vendor, client, and other sensitive company

information.

● Ensure financial transactions are supported by appropriate documentation and approvals.

● Alert leadership to collection risks, overspending, margin concerns, unusual transactions,

cash-flow concerns, or other financial risks.

● Follow company policies and internal controls related to financial transactions, payments,

approvals, and access to financial systems.



10. Finance Team Participation

● Participate in weekly finance check-ins and provide updates on outstanding accounting,

payment, collection, and cash-flow matters.

title: WE ARE HIRING IMMEDIATELY — 2 POSITIONS AVAILABLE

We are particularly interested in generating:

* Ongoing commercial cleaning contracts

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

We are looking for serious sales professionals who can deliver consistent results.

Daily Targets:

* 200 outbound calls

* 3 qualified appointments booked

* Consistent prospect follow-up

* Accurate CRM updates

* Daily performance reporting

A qualified appointment must involve a relevant decision-maker with a genuine current or potential cleaning requirement and a confirmed discussion about our services.

We value quality, consistency and actual business generated.

SALARY & PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES

In addition to your base salary, you will receive performance-based bonuses.

Only the highest applicable monthly achievement bonus is paid. Appointment and conversion bonuses are separate.

Career Growth Opportunities:

High-performing individuals may be considered for:

* Increased base salary

* Additional sales commissions

* Senior sales positions

* Account management responsibilities

* Sales team leadership opportunities

* Greater earning potential as our company expands

We are interested in developing long-term working relationships with individuals who consistently contribute to business growth.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS:

* Previous B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Clear, confident and professional communication skills

* Experience speaking with Australian or international customers

* Strong objection-handling and sales skills

* Ability to work independently

* Facilities management

* Real estate

* Construction and building

* Property management

* B2B service sales

WE WANT TOP PERFORMERS

title: Multi-Channel Marketplace & Shopify Operations Specialist (US & AU Marketplaces) - Full-Time (AEST)
description:
Job Overview:

We are an established Australian retail and e-commerce brand operating across both Australian and US sales channels. We are seeking an experienced, analytical, and highly structured Marketplace Operations Specialist.



This is NOT a marketing, content creation, or social media role. This is a technical, backend catalog and marketplace operations role. 



Your sole mission is to maintain flawless listing health, audit channels in real-time, troubleshoot feed/sync errors immediately, and ensure our catalog synchronizes accurately between Shopify, Google, and all external marketplaces (Amazon AU/US, eBay AU/US, Walmart US, and Target Plus).



Work Schedule & Compensation:

- Full-Time: 40 hours/week, aligned strictly to Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST)

- Starting Salary: 50,000 – 65,000 PHP / month (approx. $1,300 – $1,700 AUD, dependent on verified multi-channel experience)

- Direct employment (no agencies)

- Direct monthly payout via Wise or bank transfer



Core Daily Responsibilities:

1. Multi-Region Marketplace Audits: Daily morning sweep across Amazon (AU & US), eBay, Walmart, and Target Plus to check Account Health dashboards, buy box suppression, pricing parity warnings, and stranded/suppressed inventory.

2. Feed & Listing Health Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve marketplace listing errors in real-time (e.g., Amazon listing error codes 8572/5461, ASIN mapping mismatches, missing eBay Item Specifics, Walmart spec errors, and Google Merchant Center disapprovals).

3. Shopify & Connector Sync Management: Monitor connector feeds (Shopify Marketplace Connect, CedCommerce, Omnivore, etc.) to ensure price rules, regional currency conversions, and multi-location inventory counts never desync.

4. Listing Optimization: Keep titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and product attributes updated and compliant with regional standards (AU vs. US sizing/terminology).

5. Daily Standup Reporting: Deliver a structured daily log by 10:00 AM AEST documenting: Account Health scores across channels, active sync errors found, fixes deployed, and any pending seller-support tickets.



Requirements:

- 2+ years of hands-on catalog operations across BOTH Australian and US marketplaces (Amazon Seller Central, eBay, Walmart Seller Center).

- Deep experience managing Shopify backends and multi-channel feed connector apps.

- Proven familiarity with Google Merchant Center feed diagnostics.

- High operational discipline: you thrive on spreadsheets, resolving technical errors, and strict daily reporting routines without needing constant supervision.

- Stable home internet (30+ Mbps down/up) with a backup power source (UPS/generator) and secondary mobile hotspot.



HOW TO APPLY (Mandatory Video Requirement):



To prove you have the technical hands-on experience and can communicate clearly, you MUST follow these instructions. Applications without this specific video will be rejected immediately.



1. Subject Line: Must strictly read: "Marketplace Operator (AU & US) - [Your Full Name]"

2. Loom Video Application (Strict 3–4 Minute Limit): Record an unlisted Loom screen-recording with your camera on, directly addressing the following 4 points:

   - Point 1 (Platforms): Briefly walk through your hands-on experience managing Shopify alongside US & AU channels (Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Google). Which connector tools did you use to link them?

   - Point 2 (Error Troubleshooting): Describe a specific listing suppression or feed error you resolved on Amazon, Walmart, or Google. What caused the issue (e.g., GTIN mismatch, policy flag, attribute error), and how did you resolve it?

   - Point 3 (Daily Health Routine): Walk us through your morning audit routine. How would you inspect listing health across multiple platforms and report discrepancies on Australian time?

   - Point 4 (Setup): Show your Speedtest result, and explain your backup system if power or internet drops at your location.

3. Profile Links: Include links to your OnlineJobs.ph and LinkedIn profiles.

title: Remote Controller / Senior Accountant (CPA) – QuickBooks Online, Cloudbeds
description:
ABOUT US

We are a growing US hospitality group based in Arizona with two businesses:

- A 10-room luxury boutique inn

- A multi-location head spa brand that is expanding into franchising



We are hiring ONE experienced accountant to own the books and month-end close for both businesses, reporting directly to our CFO. This is a long-term, full-time role for someone who wants to own the finance function, not just do data entry.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Run the monthly close for both businesses, completed by the 3rd of each month

- Bank and credit card reconciliations in QuickBooks Online

- Use Cloudbeds revenue and payment reports to record monthly hotel revenue, prepaid reservations (deferred revenue), and payouts in QuickBooks, and reconcile the two systems each month

- Reconcile spa sales, tips, gift cards, memberships, and card processor payouts from our spa booking system (Mangomint)

- Record payroll journal entries from payroll reports and review commission reports

- Produce monthly P&L, balance sheet, and cash reports for the CFO

- Manage accounts payable entry, receipt collection, and vendor follow-up by

- Prepare sales tax and lodging tax figures for CFO review

- Keep books clean and organized for our outside tax CPA at year-end

- Set up and maintain books for new related entities as the company grows

- Document all monthly processes in a written playbook

- Light finance admin: tracking documents, following up with vendors and advisors, keeping files organized



MONTHLY REPORTING STANDARD

Our standard is "statement-verified" books, not just books that look balanced. Every month, for both businesses, you will:

- Reconcile every bank and credit card account to the actual statements, line by line, including any account not connected to QuickBooks

- Confirm all company cards and accounts are linked and nothing is missing

- Flag any difference between QuickBooks and the statements, explain it, and correct it

- Flag liabilities and risks before close (for example: taxes collected but not yet remitted, misclassified vendors, owner or related-party transactions)

- Deliver a short written close memo: what changed, what was corrected, and any open questions

- Provide the month's source reports from QuickBooks, Cloudbeds, Mangomint, and Gusto in a shared folder for executive reporting



REQUIREMENTS (MUST HAVE)

- Licensed Philippine CPA

- 3+ years running full month-end closes for US clients in QuickBooks Online

- Cloudbeds OR hotel/hospitality accounting experience

- Strong understanding of accrual accounting, deferred revenue, and reconciliations

- Excellent written English

- Reliable internet and a dedicated, private workspace



STRONG PLUS

- Experience with Mangomint or another salon/spa booking system (Vagaro, Boulevard, Zenoti, Mindbody)

- Experience with multiple entities and intercompany transactions

- Experience with Gusto payroll reports

- QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification



SCHEDULE

- Full-time, 40 hours/week

- Most work is flexible and can be done on your schedule

- 1–2 short video calls per week, scheduled during US Arizona morning hours (Philippine evening)



PAY

- $1,800 – $2,200 USD per month, based on experience

- Paid 2–4 week trial project before long-term hire

- Performance review and raise opportunity after 6 months



CONFIDENTIALITY

This role handles sensitive financial information. You will sign an NDA and work only in company-provided accounts with role-based access. You will never be asked to make payments or handle bank logins.



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject line: "CLOSE-READY CPA – [Your Name]"

Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.



In your application, answer these 5 questions:

1. How many US clients have you run a full month-end close for in QuickBooks Online, and what industries were they in?

2. Describe your experience with Cloudbeds or hotel accounting. If none, describe the closest experience you have.

3. Our hotel takes 100% payment at booking. Each month, which Cloudbeds reports would you pull to record revenue and prepaid reservations in QuickBooks, and what journal entries would you make? If you haven't used Cloudbeds, explain how you've done this with another hotel system.

4. Have you used Mangomint or any salon/spa booking system? Which one?

5. Describe a time you found a significant error or missing account while reconciling a client's books. How did you find it, and what did you do?



Finalists will complete a paid skills test reconciling sample transactions in QuickBooks Online.

title: Full-Time Amazon OA Product Sourcer
description:
FBA & FBM | Keepa & SellerAmp | Performance Incentives & Growth



Remote · 40 hours per week · Flexible schedule · Paid trial · Long-term opportunity



Build a Rewarding Role With Us



Please read the full posting before applying and follow the application instructions below.



We’re two US Amazon sellers working together to grow our Online Arbitrage businesses. We follow one shared set of sourcing standards; one seller fulfills through FBA and the other through FBM.



We’re looking for an experienced, dependable sourcer who can find profitable opportunities, research them thoroughly, and explain why they’re worth purchasing.



You’ll receive clear expectations, access to Keepa and SellerAmp, coordinated priorities, and regular feedback. In return, we expect focused effort, accurate analysis, consistent productivity, and dependable communication.



This is a serious, long-term opportunity for someone who takes ownership of their work and wants room to grow.



What You’ll Do



- Source profitable products from US retailers using manual sourcing, Keepa Product Finder, reverse sourcing, and storefront research.

- Analyze opportunities using Keepa and SellerAmp, calculating profitability for FBA or FBM as appropriate.

- Review price history, Buy Box behavior, sales demand, seasonality, Amazon’s presence, and competition trends.

- Verify exact product matches, including brand, model/UPC where available, size, color, quantity, and pack configuration. Flag packaging differences or uncertainty.

- Check selling eligibility for the assigned account using the process we provide, and flag restrictions or potential IP concerns.

- Submit complete, accurate leads in our shared Google Sheet, including product links, costs, profit, ROI, estimated sales, competition, and supporting notes.

- Identify whether each opportunity qualifies for FBA, FBM, or both. We will coordinate lead allocation and purchasing decisions.

- Provide daily written updates and participate in a weekly review meeting.



Our Sourcing Standards



- Minimum 30% ROI and $5+ net profit per unit after all applicable costs.

- Prioritize stable pricing, consistent demand, and replenishment potential.

- Prefer approximately 100+ estimated monthly sales. Opportunities with 50–99 may be considered with clear justification.

- Prefer fewer than 15 FBA sellers; flag 15+ for review. Evaluate competing FBM offers where relevant and explain whether demand supports the competition.

- Prefer listings where Amazon is not a seller. If Amazon is present, submit only opportunities with strong profitability, consistent demand, and favorable historical Buy Box data. Clearly flag Amazon’s presence and explain why the opportunity warrants consideration. All exceptions require approval.

- No clothing or shoes unless exceptionally profitable and sufficient to justify the return risk.

- No hazmat. Do not submit products the assigned seller cannot sell unless specifically requested for review.

- Avoid slow-moving, heavy, bulky, oversized, or fragile products unless specifically approved.

- Include verified gift-card discounts where instructed. Do not count cashback toward qualifying profitability.



Every lead must be thoroughly checked before submission. Do not rely solely on today’s selling price, a single sales estimate, or a profitability screenshot.



Calculate Costs Accurately



Our sourcing criteria are shared. Your calculations must reflect the fulfillment method:



- FBA: Include applicable Amazon fees, prep, inbound shipping and placement costs, and storage considerations.

- FBM: Include applicable Amazon fees, shipping to the customer, packaging, and accurate weight and dimensions.



For both methods, include applicable retailer shipping and sales tax. We will provide the cost assumptions needed for consistent calculations.



 What We’re Looking For



- Proven Amazon Online Arbitrage sourcing experience.

- Strong practical knowledge of Keepa charts, Keepa Product Finder, and SellerAmp.

- Ability to evaluate profitability for both FBA and FBM. Prior experience with both is preferred.

- Understanding of Buy Box behavior, sales velocity, competition, and realistic selling prices.

- Accurate Google Sheets work and strong attention to detail.

- Clear English communication, reliable internet, and dependable follow-through.

- Ability to work independently, explain your decisions, and apply feedback.



Attention to detail matters in this role. In your application, include “Favorite color: [your answer]” immediately after introducing yourself.



Our Expectations



Quality matters more than quantity—and consistent productivity matters too. We expect well-researched, purchase-ready leads that meet our standards, with concerns identified before we buy.



You should be proactive, communicate when you encounter challenges, and use feedback to improve. We will establish clear performance expectations during the paid trial.



Flexible Schedule, Clear Commitment



This is one full-time, 40-hour-per-week position supporting our shared sourcing operation. We will coordinate priorities and provide consistent direction.



Working hours are flexible. You should be available for brief check-ins or scheduled meetings between 9:00–10:00 a.m. US Eastern Time, as needed. Daily attendance during that window is not required.



Daily written updates and a weekly review meeting are expected.



Pay, Performance Incentives & Growth



- Starting pay: $4 USD per hour, with opportunities to progress to $5 per hour and beyond through consistent, strong performance.

- Tools provided: Keepa and SellerAmp access.

- Paid trial: Shortlisted applicants will complete a focused sourcing trial, with the scope, pay, and expectations agreed upon in advance.

- Performance incentives: Opportunities to earn bonuses based on lead quality and the sales and profitability generated. Written bonus terms will be provided before the trial.



We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with our businesses. Your starting rate is the beginning of an opportunity to earn more as you demonstrate your value and help our businesses grow.



Consistently strong performance may lead to pay increases, expanded responsibilities, and advancement into a senior sourcing or team lead role.



We value hard work, initiative, honesty, and results—and want your contribution to be recognized.



How to Apply



Introduce yourself and include:



1. Your experience: How long you’ve sourced for Amazon, the sourcing methods and tools you use, and your experience with FBA and FBM.

2. Two example leads: One suitable for FBA and one for FBM. Include the product, retailer, buy cost, selling price, estimated profit, ROI, and why it fits that fulfillment method. Previous or redacted examples are welcome.

3. Your judgment: Describe one lead you rejected and explain why.

4. Your availability: Your time zone, proposed working hours, availability for the Eastern Time check-in window, and earliest start date.



Finalists will complete a short paid trial and a brief walkthrough of their analysis.



Applications that do not follow the instructions in this posting will not be considered.



If you enjoy finding opportunities others miss, take pride in accurate work, and want a role where strong performance can lead to greater rewards, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
I’m looking for a sweet, bubbly, high-level Personal Assistant to work directly with me as my right hand. Most of this role is executive assistant work: running my calendar, priorities, making phone calls, communication, and projects. The rest is personal logistics, keeping my life outside of work organized so I can stay focused.



I’ll be upfront. This is a demanding role, not a basic admin job. You will be in the middle of everything I’m doing, day to day, as our company scales fast.



*You must speak English with little to no accent.*



About me and the company



I’m the co-founder and COO of BookDrop, a fast-growing bulk book logistics and resale company. We’ve more than doubled headcount in the last year and we’re not slowing down. I need someone who is organized, proactive, warm, and hungry to be the best assistant they can possibly be. Not someone looking for a comfortable job. Someone who wants to be trusted with real responsibility and become indispensable to an executive long-term.



The details



Full-time remote, based in the Philippines, working Arizona hours (starting 6:00 AM AZ time flexible).



What you’ll do



Act as my right-hand partner in daily execution and organization

Manage my calendar, scheduling, reminders, and priorities

Organize communication, follow-ups, and task tracking

Support operations, growth projects, and leadership workflows

Handle personal logistics: travel, appointments, purchases, family scheduling, and the small things that pile up

Build clean systems in Google Sheets and other tools

Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) every day to draft, research, organize, and move faster



This role requires serious initiative. You don’t wait to be told every step. You think ahead, bring solutions, and stay steady when things move fast.



Required skills



Advanced Google Sheets skills

Real, hands-on experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT. Non-negotiable. You should be using AI daily, not something you tried once.

*Strong English communication, written and spoken*

Highly organized and comfortable juggling many priorities at once

Tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools

Reliable internet and the ability to work US hours





Who thrives here



Wants to be THE best assistant



If you read the expectations above and felt excited instead of nervous, you’re probably who I’m looking for.





How to apply



Send your resume to 
 with “Ready to go” in the subject line and include a roughly 2-minute video covering:



What is your favorite non-fiction book and why?

Why you’d be a good fit for this role

title: Customer Service & Operations Lead — Remote, Philippines

You’ll answer calls, manage bookings, coordinate cleaning teams and resolve problems. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, makes sensible decisions and follows through without needing constant reminders.



If you enjoy solving problems, speaking with customers and helping a small business grow, we’d like to hear from you.



How to apply



Apply here: 



What you’ll do



- Answer calls,
s and messages from customers and cleaners.

- Explain our services, answer enquiries and convert suitable enquiries into accurate bookings.

- Manage schedules, assign jobs and confirm cleaner availability.

- Check upcoming bookings and resolve issues before they affect customers.

- Handle cancellations, delays, access problems and last-minute changes.

- Follow up poor feedback, de-escalate difficult conversations and arrange appropriate fixes within your authority.

- Keep customers informed and follow each issue through to resolution.

- Leave clear handover notes for your teammate.

- Help create practical SOPs, checklists and training material for future team members.



Who we’re looking for



You should have:



- Strong experience in customer service, scheduling, dispatch or service-business operations.

- Excellent spoken and written English, with near-native fluency and strong comprehension of Australian customers.

- Confidence handling natural, unscripted phone conversations, including conversations with frustrated customers.

- Good judgment and the ability to manage competing priorities.

- A reliable habit of following through on commitments.

- Confidence learning booking systems, shared inboxes and other online tools.

- A dependable computer, quality headset, quiet workspace and reliable internet, with a practical backup plan.



Experience supporting an Australian cleaning, trades, property management or other home-service business will be highly regarded. We assess clear communication and understanding; an Australian accent is not required.



An opportunity to take ownership



Our SOPs are still being developed. You’ll learn Simply Maid’s services and operations, then help document and improve how we work.



The owner will not always be immediately available. You must be comfortable making routine decisions within agreed boundaries, keeping people informed and recognising when an issue needs escalation.



Working hours and roster



Two team members will share coverage across seven days.



On your agreed rostered days, the hours are:



- 8 am–6 pm, Sydney time: on shift. Answering calls, managing bookings and handling daily operations.

- 6 pm–10 pm, Sydney time: after-hours availability. Remaining reachable for incoming calls, bookings and operational issues under agreed response expectations.



During after-hours coverage, time spent on calls, booking administration and related follow-up is recorded as paid work. Availability arrangements and any allowance will be confirmed before you accept an offer.



Your working days and expected weekly paid hours will be agreed before you start. The two roles may have different numbers of working days. Weekend rotation and shift swaps are possible by agreement, with the roster confirmed in advance.



Sydney daylight saving changes apply. Breaks, relief coverage and the full after-hours arrangements will be detailed in your written offer.



Pay and benefits



- Starting pay of AUD $12/hour for on-shift work.

- Paid onboarding and training.

- Payment for actual after-hours work at the agreed applicable rate.

- AUD $5 booking bonus for a qualifying new customer’s first booking you personally close during on-shift hours.

- AUD $10 booking bonus instead of $5 when you personally close that booking during after-hours coverage.

- AUD $25 customer recovery bonus for an approved serious complaint that you successfully resolve.

- Weekly base payments through Wise, calculated in AUD, with verified bonuses paid monthly.

- Paid time off for NSW public holidays under the agreed roster and leave arrangements.



Booking bonuses become payable once the qualifying first clean is completed and paid for. Each qualifying booking earns one booking bonus.



Customer recovery bonuses reward resolving the service issue. They do not depend on a customer changing or removing a review. Full incentive and leave terms will be provided before you start.



We use Hubstaff to record paid working time, with timesheets reviewed and approved weekly.



Grow with Simply Maid



The role begins with a three-month paid assessment period, with the intention of continuing long term if it works well for both sides.



We’ll review your progress during this period and hold a formal pay and development review after three months.



As Simply Maid grows, progression may include higher hourly pay, more guaranteed paid hours and responsibility for improving systems or training future team members. Increases will depend on your performance and sustained business growth that supports them.



Your agreed pay for work performed does not depend on achieving sales targets.



How to apply



Apply here: 



The application includes your résumé, availability, relevant experience, a short voice recording and practical scenarios.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a live interview and a paid assessment using fictional customer and scheduling situations.



Please apply through the form. Applications sent through OnlineJobs.ph messages will not be assessed.

Experience using AI tools for design, content or admin work (ChatGPT, Claude, Canva AI, Midjourney or similar).

Excellent written English.

Advertising experience is beneficial but not essential. Experience in marketing, media or campaign coordination is also a plus.

Full time, Monday to Friday, working Melbourne business hours (9:00am to 5:00pm Melbourne time). This is 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time from October to April, and 7:00am to 3:00pm Philippine time from April to October, when Melbourne daylight saving ends.

title: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist
description:
We are looking for someone who can own daily monitoring of website and landing page performance, identify where customers are dropping off, and coordinate action with media buyers and the landing page team to improve conversions.



Audit conversion performance daily

Review CVR by landing page, product, traffic source, campaign, and device.

Compare performance against recent benchmarks to catch declining pages early.

Review the full funnel: landing page → add to cart → checkout → purchase.

Account for traffic volume and traffic quality before flagging a page as underperforming.



Investigate where customers drop off

Identify which funnel step is losing customers.

Audit page speed, mobile experience, broken elements, offers, messaging, and checkout issues.

Use heatmaps and session recordings to understand friction.

Check whether the ad’s promise matches the page’s content and offer.



Give media buyers clear recommendations

Flag pages receiving spend that are underperforming.

Recommend where to redirect traffic while issues are resolved.

Identify stronger pages that could support additional spend.

Work with buyers to distinguish traffic problems from page problems, considering CPA and revenue per session alongside CVR.



Direct fixes to the landing page team

Create specific, actionable briefs explaining the issue, supporting evidence, and recommended fix.

Prioritize fixes based on revenue impact and urgency.

Assign owners and deadlines, then track changes through launch.

QA the updated page and verify whether performance improves.



Own the testing roadmap

Maintain a prioritized list of tests for headlines, offers, layouts, bundles, CTAs, and checkout.

Define success metrics before launching each test.

Track results and apply winning changes across relevant pages. 



Daily deliverable: A short update showing what dropped, where customers are leaving, likely causes, recommended spend shifts, required page fixes, and who owns each action.

title: Senior Full-Stack SaaS Developer / Technical Lead - React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL
description:
Senior Full-Stack SaaS Developer / Technical Lead — React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote - Philippines



Compensation: $2,000–$3,250 USD per month, depending on demonstrated experience, technical ability, and responsibilities.



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are modernizing and expanding TrackTool™, an established U.S.-based subscription software platform serving professionals in the surplus-funds recovery industry.



TrackTool is designed to be a complete 'Business in a Box', combining lead management, claimant research, case tracking, employee permissions, communications, document management, financial analysis, and third-party integrations into one comprehensive platform.



We are seeking an exceptional Senior Full-Stack SaaS Developer / Technical Lead who can do significantly more than create websites or attractive user interfaces.



We need someone capable of evaluating existing software, designing sound technical architecture, developing sophisticated functionality, securing customer information, and maintaining and continually improving the platform.



You will work directly with the business owner, who provides detailed functional specifications, business workflows, and user-interface mockups.



Our goal is to establish a long-term working relationship with a highly capable developer who can take responsibility for TrackTool's technical development and eventually lead additional developers as the company grows.



IMPORTANT - EXISTING SOFTWARE EVALUATION



WE ARE NOT AUTOMATICALLY LOOKING TO DISCARD OUR EXISTING SOFTWARE AND START FROM SCRATCH.



TrackTool has an established codebase, an existing database, functioning modules, integrations, and years of accumulated development and business logic.



Our first priority is to determine what existing software can be salvaged, improved, modernized, or reused before spending money rebuilding functionality that may already work.



The selected developer's first assignment will be a separate, paid technical assessment of the existing software and any newer development materials made available for review.



The assessment will include:



- Reviewing existing PHP/CodeIgniter source code and available modernization work.

- Evaluating database structures, relationships, and existing functionality.

- Identifying reusable code, business logic, workflows, integrations, and document templates.

- Evaluating the security, quality, performance, and maintainability of existing modules.

- Determining which components should be reused, refactored, migrated, or replaced.

- Identifying outdated dependencies and potential technical risks.

- Evaluating approaches to preserving existing customer information and historical records.

- Comparing phased modernization with a complete rebuild.



The developer must provide a written technical assessment detailing recommended actions, technical architecture, estimated development phases, timelines, and costs.



We want someone who understands that good software engineering means making financially responsible decisions—not automatically rebuilding everything from zero.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Following the initial evaluation and approval of the development plan, responsibilities will include:



- Designing and developing TrackTool using TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, or an approved alternative.

- Building a secure multi-tenant SaaS architecture that keeps every subscribing company's records and employees properly separated.

- Developing CRM functionality, lead management, claimant research, case tracking, dashboards, and reporting.

- Implementing customizable roles, permissions, employee assignments, and administrative controls.

- Developing financial modules for commissions, profitability, expenses, customer wallets, and usage-based services.

- Integrating outside providers for skip tracing, research, telecommunications, payments, and document processing.

- Developing secure backend APIs, database operations, automation, and background processing.

- Building responsive interfaces for desktop, tablet, and mobile users.

- Establishing secure development, testing, staging, and production environments.

- Implementing automated tests, backup procedures, monitoring, and appropriate security controls.

- Maintaining complete, organized, documented source code in company-controlled repositories.

- Providing weekly progress reports, demonstrations, and realistic completion estimates.

- Maintaining, troubleshooting, improving, and expanding TrackTool after its initial modernization.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



This is a senior-level position. We are not looking for a beginner or someone learning these technologies while working on our system.



Applicants should have:



- At least 5 years of professional full-stack development experience.

- Substantial experience developing and maintaining production SaaS applications.

- Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, and relational SQL databases.

- Experience with PostgreSQL or comparable production databases.

- Demonstrated experience designing secure multi-tenant SaaS systems.

- Strong understanding of authentication, backend authorization, role-based permissions, and customer-data isolation.

- Experience with financial calculations, transactions, payments, subscriptions, and third-party billing integrations.

- Experience with external APIs, webhooks, retries, and error handling.

- Experience migrating or modernizing existing software and databases.

- Proficiency with Git, GitHub, automated testing, and controlled deployments.

- Knowledge of software security, data protection, logging, backups, and disaster recovery.

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

- Ability to clearly explain complex technical matters to a nontechnical business owner.

- Strong problem-solving skills, personal accountability, and attention to detail.

- Willingness to take ownership of technical responsibilities and maintain the application long-term.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



- PHP/CodeIgniter modernization

- PostgreSQL row-level security

- Stripe subscriptions and payment processing

- Twilio phone and SMS integrations

- CRM and business-management applications

- Automated PDF and document generation

- E-signature services

- Third-party data-provider integrations

- Cloud hosting, CI/CD, and server administration

- Financial ledgers and prepaid customer wallet systems

- React Native and mobile application development

- Supervising or mentoring developers



Experience developing a commercial CRM, subscription-based SaaS platform, or complex business-management application will receive special consideration.



COMPENSATION AND LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are offering a long-term opportunity with a growing U.S.-based software business.



Our hiring process is structured in stages:



Stage 1 - Paid Technical Skills Assessment



Shortlisted finalists will be offered a paid programming assessment using fictional information to demonstrate their technical abilities.



Stage 2 -Paid Existing Software Assessment



The selected candidate will evaluate our existing application and provide a written technical recommendation.



Stage 3 - Ongoing Full-Time Development



Following a successful assessment and approval of a development plan, we intend to establish a long-term development relationship.



Compensation will be agreed in writing for each engagement stage. For the ongoing position, salary and responsibilities will be reviewed at clearly established performance milestones.



We offer:



- Competitive compensation based on proven experience and ability.

- Long-term, full-time remote opportunity.

- Direct communication with the business owner.

- Detailed project requirements and application mockups.

- Opportunities for increasing compensation and responsibilities.

- Potential technical leadership as our development team grows.

- A professional relationship focused on communication, reliability, and high-quality work.



COMPANY OWNERSHIP AND CONFIDENTIALITY



The selected developer must sign a written confidentiality, intellectual property, and software development agreement before receiving access to proprietary code or confidential company systems.



All newly commissioned source code, documentation, and related deliverables must be assigned to the TrackTool business under the written agreement.



All company infrastructure, repositories, database access, and development environments will remain under company control.



This is a compensated development role, not an equity, co-founder, or revenue-sharing opportunity.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer all seven questions below. We prefer specific, thoughtful answers demonstrating your actual experience.



1. PREVIOUS SAAS EXPERIENCE



Describe one or two commercial SaaS applications you personally developed or helped architect.



Provide links where possible and explain exactly what you built.



2. TECHNICAL EXPERTISE



How many years have you worked with React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and related technologies?



Describe your experience with cloud hosting, testing, deployment, and maintenance.



3. MULTI-TENANT SECURITY



Suppose 100 companies subscribe to the same software platform.



How would you ensure each company can access only its own employees, case records, documents, and financial information?



How would you prevent unauthorized access through modified URLs, API requests, or database queries?



4. FINANCIAL SYSTEMS AND API INTEGRATIONS



Describe a payment-processing system, subscription platform, prepaid customer wallet, or financial transaction system you have built.



How did you prevent duplicate charges, maintain accurate records, and handle failed payments or API requests?



5. LEGACY SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE



Have you worked with PHP, CodeIgniter, or other older business applications?



Describe how you would evaluate an existing system before recommending modernization or replacement.



6. SALVAGING EXISTING SOFTWARE



Imagine reviewing a CRM with thousands of source-code files, an established database, working integrations, and years of business logic.



How would you determine which components should be kept, improved, or rebuilt?



Please describe a similar project you have personally completed, if applicable.



7. AVAILABILITY AND COMPENSATION



Please provide:



- Your expected monthly compensation in USD.

- Your earliest available starting date.

- Your availability for long-term, full-time work.

- Your preferred working hours and overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

- Whether you have other employment or significant ongoing projects.

- Your willingness to participate in a paid technical assessment and a separately compensated code audit.



HIRING TIMELINE



We are accepting applications immediately and anticipate beginning interviews during the week of November 4, 2026.



Paid technical evaluations and start dates will be arranged with shortlisted candidates.



We are more interested in finding the right long-term developer than rushing into a hiring decision.



IMPORTANT - APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



ATTENTION TO DETAIL AND FOLLOWING WRITTEN SPECIFICATIONS ARE ESSENTIAL FOR THIS POSITION.



To be considered, your application MUST meet BOTH requirements below.



REQUIREMENT #1 - EXACT APPLICATION SUBJECT LINE



Your application subject line must be exactly:



TRACK. MANAGE. RECOVER. - TrackTool Senior Developer



Do not change, abbreviate, or add anything to this subject line.



If the application platform does not permit editing the subject line, use the exact wording above as the very first line of your application instead.



REQUIREMENT #2 - ATTENTION-TO-DETAIL TEST



Somewhere in your application, include a working website link to a publicly accessible webpage displaying a photograph of a:



BLUE 1970 FORD MUSTANG FASTBACK



The link must lead to a webpage where the requested vehicle can be viewed.



Do not attach an image, submit an AI-generated picture, or provide a general image-search results page.



PLEASE NOTE



These two requirements are intentional.



They help identify applicants who read carefully, demonstrate attention to detail, and follow written instructions accurately.



Applications missing either requirement will not be considered, regardless of experience or qualifications.



We value technical expertise, professional integrity, accountability, communication, and the ability to follow detailed specifications.



We look forward to hearing from experienced developers who want to become a long-term part of TrackTool's future.

Accounts & Finance Administration Support



Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Accounts & Finance Administrator to manage the company’s day-to-day invoicing, payment processing, reconciliations, and financial administration across stores, agencies, partners and suppliers.

This role is responsible for ensuring accurate financial records, timely payment processing, account reconciliation, and maintaining clean and up-to-date data within Xero and banking platforms. The position is responsible for the operational finance processes and maintaining strong communication with agency finance teams, commercial teams and sales teams.



Key Responsibilities

Accounts Receivable & Payables

• Monthly statement of accounts to be sent to all clients where an invoice/s is outstanding. To be sent 10th of each month.

• Request remittances from all agencies that have invoices due that month. Request to be sent 2nd week of month.

• Allocate all Banking payments/ XERO payments to invoices payable, detailing the date of payment.

• Reconcile all receivable (agency) and payable (stores/partners/suppliers) in Xero against applicable invoices and/or payments as shown in Banking account.

• Send remittance advice to stores once payments are processed in Xero and Bank. This requires daily checking and updating Xero bills.

Payment Processing & Reconciliations

• Bi-monthly payment entries for directors approval of banking transaction payments.

• Create bills in Xero for each store payment for adhoc (one off months) and reoccurring (QTR). 

• Remove paid stores from Xero in bills-paid once remittances are completed to avoid duplicate payments. Every payment to be removed, then void of out bills.

• Maintain accurate financial records and investigate discrepancies where required.

Financial Administration & System Maintenance

• Enter campaign booking confirmations into Xero via per campaign, per monthly invoices.

• Cross-check monthly invoices against sales tracker to ensure billing accuracy. Sales team to be informed of any discrepancies.

• Remove closed or inactive stores from Xero and Banking systems (ensure this is done – check required)

• Maintain clean and accurate financial databases and payment records.

• Support ongoing financial reporting and administration requirements.

 

What You’ll Bring

• Experience in accounts administration, bookkeeping, or finance coordination.

• Strong working knowledge of Xero and banking reconciliation processes.

• High attention to detail and strong organisational skills.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

• Strong communication and follow-up skills when dealing with agencies, internal teams and partners.

About BP Construction



BP Construction Company is a growing construction company based in San Antonio, Texas, USA. We specialize in commercial and residential construction, including wood framing, metal stud framing, drywall, insulation, acoustical ceilings, and general contracting projects.



We are hiring an experienced Construction Estimator who can independently manage the complete estimating and bidding process from start to finish.



BP Construction Company is seeking an experienced construction estimator who can independently prepare complete and accurate estimates for U.S. commercial construction projects.



We specialize in:



Commercial metal stud framing



Commercial wood framing



Drywall installation



Batt and sound insulation



Acoustical ceiling systems (ACT)



Exterior sheathing



Rough carpentry and blocking



This position requires direct experience estimating U.S. commercial drywall and framing projects.



We are not looking for someone who only performs basic square-footage takeoffs.



Responsibilities



Review architectural and structural drawings, specifications, and addenda.



Perform detailed material takeoffs using Bluebeam, PlanSwift, or equivalent software.



Prepare wall-by-wall framing and drywall takeoffs.



Calculate accurate material quantities, waste factors, and labor costs.



Request and compare material quotations from U.S. suppliers.



Prepare complete estimates, including labor, materials, equipment, overhead, and profit.



Identify scope gaps, specification conflicts, exclusions, and RFIs.



Maintain organized estimating worksheets and supporting documentation.



Prepare bid proposals for management approval.



Meet commercial bid deadlines with minimal supervision.



IMPORTANT: Required Takeoff Format



All framing and drywall takeoffs must include individual wall dimensions.



Metal Framing:



Wall type and location



Individual wall lengths



Wall heights and required stud lengths



Stud sizes, gauges, and spacing



Track quantities



Blocking, bracing, and other required components



Drywall:



Individual wall lengths and heights



Board type and thickness



Number of layers on each side



Board sizes and sheet quantities



Ceiling drywall where applicable



Providing only total SF or LF quantities is not acceptable. Detailed takeoffs must allow BP Construction to verify measurements and prepare accurate material orders.



Required Qualifications



At least 3 years of relevant construction estimating experience.



Previous experience estimating U.S. commercial metal framing and drywall projects.



Strong knowledge of U.S. construction drawings and specifications.



Proficiency in Bluebeam, PlanSwift, or similar estimating software.



Advanced Excel skills, including formulas and organized estimating workbooks.



Ability to independently prepare complete bids.



Strong written and spoken English.



Reliable internet connection and computer.



Ability to meet deadlines and communicate regularly.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your updated resume.



Your expected hourly rate in USD.



The estimating software you use and whether you have your own licensed software.



Examples of previous U.S. commercial drywall and metal framing estimates or takeoffs (confidential information may be removed).



A brief explanation of how you calculate stud quantities and drywall sheet quantities from wall lengths and heights.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a Google Meet interview with screen sharing and a paid estimating assessment.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position with BP Construction Company.

title: Asset & Lease Manager
description:
Asset & Lease Manager

Own the administration of a multi-site U.S. retail lease portfolio: abstract leases, track critical dates, verify every landlord charge before it is paid, and recover overbilled CAM and tax charges.



Work Setup

Full-time, Monday–Friday, night shift

Must have a computer with a webcam

Reliable high-speed internet



What You'll Do

Abstract every executed lease and amendment (rent, escalations, CAM/tax/insurance terms, options, notice windows, exclusives, co-tenancy) into the lease database.

Maintain the critical date calendar (options, renewals, termination rights, TI deadlines, insurance renewals, estoppels) and give advance notice.

Route and file leases, amendments, estoppels, SNDAs and consents, and keep an indexed digital lease file.

Set up rent records at commencement and keep escalations, amendments and abatements current.

Validate every monthly billing (base rent, CAM, tax, insurance, percentage rent) against the lease before payment, and prepare the payment file for Accounting.

Manage the outsourced CAM and tax audit, review findings against the lease, and track approved claims through to credit or refund.

Screen year-end reconciliations on receipt and correct errors right away.

Track real estate tax bills and assessments, verify pro-rata shares, and flag protest candidates.

Issue and maintain certificates of insurance for every location to each lease's requirements.

Monitor landlord obligations and put landlords on notice when they are unmet.

Maintain W-9s, landlord and property manager records, and payment instructions, with verified controls on any banking changes.

Support franchisor and lender consent, estoppel and reporting requests.

Act as the day-to-day contact for property managers on statements, reconciliations, certificates and documents.

Prepare and file TI allowance draw packages and track them through to receipt.

Support back-charge claims and portfolio events such as closures, relocations, assignments and subleases.

Keep the lease database accurate, and produce recurring reports (critical dates, rent roll, occupancy cost, audit savings, insurance compliance).

Write and maintain SOPs, and help define, train and supervise a future associate role.



What We're Looking For

4+ years in U.S. retail or commercial lease administration, lease accounting or property accounting, ideally with multi-site portfolios

Ability to read and accurately abstract U.S. shopping-center leases, including CAM, tax and insurance pass-throughs, caps, exclusions, options and notice requirements

Working knowledge of CAM and real estate tax reconciliations, with the ability to spot improper charges and hold a position with landlords or audit firms

Experience managing certificates of insurance against lease-specific requirements

Advanced Excel

Excellent written and spoken English for direct, professional correspondence with U.S. landlords and property managers

Exceptional accuracy and follow-through, and comfort owning a deadline calendar where a missed date has real financial consequences

Preferred: a degree in Accounting, Finance, Real Estate, Business or Law

Preferred: experience with a lease administration platform, e-signature tools and an ERP/AP system

Preferred: experience supporting a growing portfolio (new openings, TI collection) or working with a U.S.-based team from offshore

title: Legal Intake Specialist (Sales)
description:
ABOUT US

All 50 Law is a US-based, rapidly expanding personal injury law firm dedicated to helping individuals who have recently suffered an injury secure the legal support they need. We are quickly growing to become one of the largest marketing and referral-based law firms in the country. Behind our fast-paced, highly automated marketing machine is a powerhouse team: our founder is a Harvard Law School graduate, and our technical infrastructure is driven by a specialized team of product engineers holding Master’s degrees and PhDs in Computer Science.



THE ROLE

This is not a traditional administrative legal role; it is a high-performance sales position designed for a natural closer. We are seeking an individual who is assertive and competitive, yet highly people-oriented and relationship-focused. You must operate with a strong sense of urgency and adaptability, requiring a candidate who possesses balanced independence and procedural discipline. In this role, the specialist sells via phone or digital channels. You will be someone who expertly manages a pipeline and drives revenue without face-to-face interaction. Your primary objective is to build rapid trust, skillfully overcome hesitations, and guide prospects to retain our partner law firms.



A DAY IN THE LIFE

When you log in to your dedicated workspace, you will immediately dive into our custom GoHighLevel CRM. Your day will be heavily phone-based and fast-paced. You will constantly monitor incoming pipelines and jump on fresh, warm leads the moment our marketing engine generates them.



You will spend your hours speaking directly with individuals who have recently experienced an injury, requiring you to balance empathy with strong conversational control. You will ask targeted qualifying questions, navigate objections, and firmly guide eligible prospects toward signing a representation agreement. Between calls, you will aggressively manage your sales pipeline, send follow-up text messages,
s, and update client records with meticulous accuracy. You are the vital first point of contact, operating at a high frequency to turn inbound inquiries into closed deals.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

*Jump on Fresh Leads: Act with speed to engage immediately with individuals who have suffered injuries. Because these are warm leads expecting your call, your "speed to lead" is critical in capturing their interest while they are actively exploring their legal options.



*Qualify & Convert: Actively listen and assess each caller's case eligibility based on strict, provided criteria. You will ask targeted questions to uncover key details, seamlessly transitioning from qualification to the close.



*Control the Conversation: Use persuasive, confident communication to "sell" the advantages of working with our legal network. You must expertly navigate objections, instill trust, and motivate prospective clients to take the next step of signing their agreements.



*Manage Multiple Channels: Juggle prospect communication across phone calls, SMS text messages,
s, and social media direct messages to ensure systematic follow-up.



*Accurate Execution: Maintain impeccable detail orientation while logging notes and updating statuses. Your procedural discipline ensures our automated systems fire correctly and client data is preserved.



WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

*The "Hunter" Mentality: You are highly motivated, thrive on hitting targets, and get energized by closing deals.



*Extroverted & Outgoing Personality: You are naturally comfortable asserting yourself and taking control of a conversation. You build rapport instantly and can handle emotionally charged situations with professional confidence.



*Phone Presence: You are comfortable spending the majority of your shift on the phone. You maintain a high level of enthusiasm, empathy, and energy from your first dial to your last.



*Communication Mastery: You possess fluent English with very little or no detectable accent, ensuring crystal-clear communication and immediate trust-building with our clientele.



*Technical Proficiency: You have hands-on experience navigating the GoHighLevel CRM (or similar advanced sales platforms) and can quickly adapt to our proprietary technological tools.



*Remote Work Ready: You have a dedicated and distraction-free home workspace, supported by a reliable, high-speed internet connection.



WHAT WE OFFER

*Competitive Base + Uncapped Commission: Start with a $10/hr base rate, augmented by a lucrative commission structure. High performers have the clear opportunity to push $40k+/yr in total compensation through uncapped commissions and performance incentives.



*Cutting-Edge Tech Stack: Work within a custom-built instance of GoHighLevel, supercharged by proprietary tools and automation developed in-house by our software engineering team.



*Warm, High-Intent Leads: 100% of the leads you engage with have actively requested our help and are expecting to hear from you.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include a link to a voice recording saying: "Hi Ryan, my name is [your name] with All 50 Law. I'm following up on the form you submitted to us through
 seeking legal representation. Please call me back at your earliest convenience." Applications without this recording will not be considered.
