title: Online Reputation Management and Community Forum Specialist
description:
[Online Reputation Management and Community Forum Specialist]



TYPE OF WORK: Part Time (20 hours/week), with potential to convert to full-time (40 hours/week)

WAGE / SALARY: $8.00 to $9.00 per hour, depending on verified experience

HOURS PER WEEK: 20 to start

LOCATION: Remote (Philippines)



ABOUT US

We are a US based brand selling automotive covers and accessories. We sell through our own website and through Amazon and eBay.



POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for an experienced Online Reputation Management specialist to help strengthen our brand's presence across online communities and improve branded search results.



The primary focus of this role is monitoring and participating in relevant forums, identifying reputation risks, and helping legitimate positive or neutral content outrank negative search results over time.



This isn't primarily a customer-service or review-response position. Candidates should have direct experience with online communities, branded search results, content promotion, and ethical reputation-suppression strategies.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Community Forum Management

- Find relevant forums and online communities where customers discuss our brand, products, competitors, or industry.

- Monitor discussions for brand mentions, complaints, misinformation, product questions, and reputation risks.

- Participate through useful, natural, and non-promotional contributions.

- Draft thoughtful responses that don't sound defensive, scripted, or overly promotional.

- Identify forum discussions that rank for branded searches and recommend an appropriate response strategy.

- Track discussion URLs, dates, topics, responses, engagement, and search visibility.

- Escalate legal threats, safety complaints, refund disputes, coordinated attacks, or potentially defamatory content.



Branded Search and Reputation Suppression

- Monitor priority searches involving the brand name, reviews, complaints, scams, customer service, and relevant product terms.

- Identify negative URLs, their ranking positions, content types, authority, sentiment, and likelihood of being displaced.

- Help develop ethical suppression strategies using legitimate owned, earned, and third-party assets.

- Optimize company profiles, social profiles, business listings, articles, videos, interviews, and other brand-related assets.

- Coordinate the creation and promotion of useful branded content that can occupy additional first-page search positions.

- Monitor ranking changes and recommend adjustments based on actual performance.

- Distinguish between results that may be corrected, removed, responded to, deindexed, or outranked.



Content and Reputation Assets

- Develop content briefs for branded articles, FAQs, company profiles, interviews, case studies, customer stories, and expert content.

- Support legitimate third-party placements, contributor opportunities, interviews, partnerships, and company profiles.

- Improve the credibility of reputation assets through accurate company information, identifiable authorship, firsthand experience, original media, and expert commentary.

- Coordinate with SEO, content, customer service, and leadership when public responses or new assets require approval.



Monitoring and Reporting

- Track page-one and page-two results for priority branded searches.

- Monitor new forum discussions, articles, reviews, and brand mentions.

- Maintain a weekly tracker covering negative URL positions, positive and neutral assets on pages one and two, new brand mentions, discussions requiring action, assets created or optimized, ranking changes, open risks, and recommended next steps.



MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- At least two years of hands-on experience in online reputation management, community management, branded SEO, or search-result suppression.

- Direct experience monitoring and participating in established online forums or communities.

- Experience evaluating branded search results and tracking the positions of negative, positive, and neutral URLs.

- Strong written English and the ability to adapt to the tone and rules of different communities.

- Basic working knowledge of SEO, search intent, content optimization, links, authority, and indexing.

- Ability to recognize when a public response could make a situation worse and should be escalated.

- Strong research, documentation, organization, and reporting skills.

- Ability to provide specific examples of past work and clearly explain your individual contribution.



NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience managing ORM for an e-commerce or consumer brand.

- Experience improving branded search results through content, profiles, videos, digital PR, or legitimate third-party placements.

- Experience securing interviews, articles, contributor opportunities, citations, or editorial mentions.

- Familiarity with Google Business Profile, Trustpilot, BBB, social platforms, video platforms, and industry-specific forums.

- Experience using Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, rank-tracking platforms, or brand-monitoring tools.

- Knowledge of on-page SEO, internal linking, digital PR, entity optimization, and content distribution.

- Experience working with customer-service teams on complaint escalation and resolution.



PROHIBITED TACTICS

We're only interested in legitimate, sustainable reputation-management practices. The following tactics aren't permitted:

- Fake customer accounts or fabricated personal identities

- Fake reviews, testimonials, or customer experiences

- Review gating or incentives offered only for positive reviews

- Mass forum posting, automated comments, or spam links

- Harassment, intimidation, or coordinated reporting campaigns

- Misrepresenting an affiliation with the company

- Publishing false allegations about competitors

- Promising guaranteed removals or guaranteed ranking results



Candidates should be comfortable disclosing a company affiliation when required by a platform or when the relationship would materially affect how readers interpret a recommendation.



PERFORMANCE MEASURES

- Movement of priority negative URLs in branded search results

- Growth of legitimate positive and neutral assets on page one

- Quality and relevance of community participation

- Reputation risks identified before they escalate

- Accuracy and completeness of weekly reporting

- Quality of content, profile, and placement recommendations

- Compliance with company and community guidelines



Search-result suppression isn't guaranteed and may require several months, depending on the authority of the negative result and the competitiveness of the branded search.



WORK ARRANGEMENT

- Remote, part-time contractor position

- 20 hours per week to start, Monday to Friday, 4 hours a day. Hours can increase up to 40 based on performance and workload

- Your 4 hours fall within 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM US Pacific Time (10:00 PM to 6:30 AM Philippine Time). The exact block is set with your manager once you start

- Paid through Wise, on schedule

- Weekly progress reporting is required

- Some daily monitoring of brand mentions and community discussions may be needed

- During the initial training period, public responses and activity in new communities need approval before they go out



A NOTE ON APPLYING

If you have not done something, just say so in your answers. "I have not done that" costs you nothing here. What does count against you is describing work you did not personally do.



The role starts at 20 hours and can grow to 40, with the rate reviewed as the scope grows.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph or
 
 NOT apply to 



Put COVERLAND at the start of your application, either in the subject line or as the first line of your message. Then answer all five questions below. Applications that skip questions, or answer in general terms without specific examples, will not be reviewed.



1. Brand and Project Scope

Describe one brand for which you personally handled online reputation management. Include:

- The industry or business type

- The month and year you started and finished

- Your exact responsibilities

- The number of negative results appearing within the first two pages of Google when you started

- Whether you worked independently or as part of a team

You may omit or anonymize the brand name if required by a confidentiality agreement.



2. Search-Result Movement

Choose one negative URL from that project and provide:

- The type of website on which it appeared

- Its approximate starting Google position

- Its approximate ending position

- The amount of time required

- The specific tactics you personally implemented

- How you tracked and verified the ranking movement

Do not claim that a result was suppressed if it only moved temporarily or disappeared because of a search-location change.



3. Community Forum Experience

Describe one forum or online-community situation you personally managed. Include the type of community, what you posted or recommended, whether you disclosed the brand relationship, and the outcome.



4. Strategy Scenario

A negative forum discussion ranks fourth when someone searches for a company's brand name. The discussion is several years old, but the forum has strong authority and the thread still receives occasional comments.

Explain how you would evaluate the result and what you would prioritize during the first 30, 60, and 90 days. Identify anything you would avoid doing and explain why.



5. Tools and Reporting

List the SEO, monitoring, community, and reporting tools you've used, and what you would include in a weekly ORM report. If available, attach a redacted example of a report or ranking tracker you personally prepared.



Please attach your resume.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a two-hour assessment. It is paid, whether or not you move forward.

title: Accounting Assistant
description:
Job Summary:

The Accounting Officer manages Consilium Labs’ day-to-day financial operations, ensuring accurate

financial records, timely invoicing and collections, disciplined expense management, reliable reporting,

and effective financial controls. The role supports leadership with clear financial visibility while helping

protect profitability, cash flow, and operational discipline.



Duties & Responsibilities:

1. Bank Management & Payments

● Manage and monitor company bank accounts, including daily balances, transactions, transfers,

and account activity.

● Review and process approved vendor, employee, tax, and other company payments in

accordance with established approval procedures.

● Schedule and coordinate payments to ensure obligations are paid accurately and on time.

● Maintain visibility into upcoming payment obligations and available cash balances to support

short-term cash-flow planning.

● Prepare payment requests and ensure appropriate approvals and supporting documentation are

obtained before payments are processed.

● Maintain payment records, bank confirmations, remittance information, and other supporting

documentation.

● Monitor recurring payments and upcoming obligations and escalate potential cash-flow concerns

or payment issues to leadership.

● Coordinate with banks and payment providers regarding account maintenance, transaction

issues, access, and required documentation.

● Investigate unusual or unauthorized transactions and promptly escalate material issues.

2. Billing & Accounts Receivable



● Prepare and issue accurate client invoices on time based on approved contracts, billing

schedules, and supporting information.

● Assist with billing setup for new contracts and maintain accurate billing information in relevant

systems.

● Monitor accounts-receivable aging reports and follow up professionally on overdue balances.

● Maintain accurate payment records, remittance tracking, and collection documentation.

● Maintain accurate accounts-receivable aging and promptly investigate billing or payment

discrepancies.

● Alert leadership to significant collection risks or overdue balances.

3. Accounts Payable & Vendor Management

● Review vendor invoices, payment approvals, vendor files, and payment history for accuracy and

completeness.

● Process and schedule vendor payments only after required approvals have been obtained.

● Maintain accurate accounts-payable aging and visibility into upcoming vendor obligations.

● Support vendor onboarding and maintain accurate vendor records and payment information.

● Ensure expenses are properly coded, documented, and recorded in the accounting system.

● Investigate discrepancies between invoices, payment records, and accounting records.

4. Accounting & Reconciliations

● Maintain accurate and complete accounting records and supporting documentation.

● Perform monthly bank, credit-card, and balance-sheet reconciliations.

● Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies in a timely manner.

● Maintain consistency and data integrity across accounting, invoicing, payment, and related

billing systems.

● Support a timely and accurate month-end close process.

● Ensure transactions are properly classified and recorded in accordance with company accounting

procedures.

5. Payroll & Employee-Related Accounting

● Coordinate the financial processing of payroll with payroll providers based on employee and

payroll changes provided and approved by the appropriate parties.

● Maintain commission schedules, bonus tracking, reimbursement logs, and year-end payroll

documentation based on approved inputs from department owners and management.

● Ensure payroll-related accounting entries and supporting documentation are accurate and

complete.

6. Financial Reporting & Cash Flow

● Prepare monthly management reports covering revenue, expenses, margins, collections, and

cash balances.

● Support budget-versus-actual reporting and investigate significant variances.

● Maintain visibility into expected cash inflows, upcoming payment obligations, and short-term

cash-flow requirements.

● Provide management with timely financial information and escalate material cash-flow,

overspending, margin, collection, or other financial risks.

● Identify unusual transactions or financial trends that require management attention.



7. Month-End, Tax & External Support

● Support the month-end close by ensuring required transactions, reconciliations, and supporting

schedules are completed accurately and on time.

● Maintain organized records for audits, tax filings, insurance requirements, regulatory requests,

and other financial documentation.

● Support external CPAs, tax preparers, auditors, and other financial advisors by providing

requested records and information.

● Assist with year-end accounting and tax-related documentation as required.

8. Finance Systems, Processes & Controls

● Maintain accurate and consistent information across accounting, invoicing, banking, payment,

and related financial systems.

● Assist with billing setup, vendor onboarding, and payment-system administration.

● Identify opportunities to improve finance workflows, controls, processes, and automation.

● Support implementation and maintenance of procedures designed to improve accuracy,

efficiency, and visibility.

● Promptly investigate and resolve discrepancies between financial systems and source

documentation.

9. Risk Management & Confidentiality

● Maintain strict confidentiality of financial, payroll, vendor, client, and other sensitive company

information.

● Ensure financial transactions are supported by appropriate documentation and approvals.

● Alert leadership to collection risks, overspending, margin concerns, unusual transactions,

cash-flow concerns, or other financial risks.

● Follow company policies and internal controls related to financial transactions, payments,

approvals, and access to financial systems.

10. Finance Team Participation

● Participate in weekly finance check-ins and provide updates on outstanding accounting,

payment, collection, and cash-flow matters.

● Participate in quarterly performance reviews and annual compensation reviews.

● Collaborate with management and relevant department owners to ensure timely and accurate

financial processing and reporting.

Required Skills & Abilities:

● Strong accounting, bookkeeping, invoicing, accounts-receivable, and accounts-payable skills.

● Ability to prepare accurate reconciliations and financial reports.

● Strong attention to detail, organization, accuracy, and financial discipline.

● Proficiency with Excel or spreadsheet tools and bookkeeping/accounting systems.

● Ability to manage multiple financial deadlines, records, and priorities.

● Professional written and verbal communication skills for client, vendor, banking, and advisor

interactions.

● Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial information appropriately.

● Strong problem-solving, follow-up, process-improvement, and ownership mindset.

● Ability to recognize and escalate financial, collection, cash-flow, and margin risks.



Education & Experience:

● Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Bookkeeping, or related background preferred.

● 3+ years of experience with bookkeeping systems, invoicing, payroll coordination, and financial

reconciliations preferred.

● Strong Excel or spreadsheet experience preferred.

● Experience in a professional-services or service-business environment preferred.



How To Apply:

Send your application with the subject line Accounting Assistant – [Your Full Name] and include:

-Your updated CV

-A link to a 2-minute video introduction highlighting your accounting experience and qualities that set you apart from other candidates.



We value attention to detail and applicants who follow instructions carefully, so please make sure to include all the required materials. See you online!

title: 2D Landscape Drafting Specialist
description:
We’re Hiring: 2D Landscape Drafting Specialist



Your Haven Design | Full-Time | Remote | US Night Shift



Your Haven Design is looking for an experienced 2D Landscape Drafter who can turn approved landscape concepts into accurate, detailed, and construction-ready working drawings. We’re looking for someone with a strong technical background in landscape drafting, a sharp eye for detail, and the ability to translate design intent into clear plans that landscape contractors can use for project execution.



Important: Applicants must be willing and able to work night shifts aligned with US business hours.



About Your Haven Design



Your Haven Design works with landscape contractors across the United States, helping them bring outdoor living spaces to life through detailed 3D designs and professional landscape plans. Our projects include luxury residential landscapes, outdoor living areas, pools, planting layouts, hardscape features, and more.



The Role



You will take finalized landscape concepts and develop them into complete, well-organized 2D working drawings. Your responsibility is to ensure that the approved design is accurately represented, properly documented, and ready for the next stage of project planning and construction.



You will:



- Convert approved landscape concepts and 3D designs into detailed 2D landscape working drawings.

- Prepare landscape layout plans, planting plans, hardscape plans, dimensions, annotations, and other required technical drawings.

- Interpret SketchUp models, design references, site plans, and project notes to produce accurate 2D documentation.

- Ensure drawings follow project requirements, drafting standards, and established company guidelines.

- Check dimensions, alignments, labels, line weights, symbols, and drawing consistency before submission.

- Coordinate with landscape designers, project managers, and design leads to resolve discrepancies and clarify design details.

- Manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines and maintaining consistent drawing quality.

- Review feedback, make revisions, and ensure the final plans accurately reflect the approved design.



What We’re Looking For



You must have at least 5 years of professional experience producing 2D plans for landscape design projects. You understand the difference between a presentation drawing and a technical working drawing, and you know how to prepare plans that are clear, accurate, and practical for contractors to use.



Our ideal candidate has:



- At least 5 years of experience in 2D landscape drafting, particularly for residential properties and outdoor living projects.

- Strong proficiency in AutoCAD and the ability to produce clean, accurate, well-organized technical drawings.

- A good understanding of landscape layouts, planting arrangements, hardscape features, dimensions, and site conditions.

- The ability to interpret 3D landscape designs and translate them into complete 2D working drawings without changing the approved design intent.

- Strong attention to detail, technical accuracy, and drawing presentation standards.

- The ability to manage multiple assignments, work independently, and meet deadlines in a remote environment.

- Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with designers and project managers.

- Willingness and ability to work a full-time night shift aligned with US business hours. This is a requirement for the position.



Preferred Qualifications



- Previous experience working with a US-based landscaping or landscape design company, particularly on residential projects.

- Familiarity with US landscape plan conventions, residential site plans, and common construction documentation practices.

- Experience using SketchUp, SketchUp Lay-Out, or other 3D design tools.

- Experience preparing planting plans, hardscape layouts, dimensioned plans, and other technical landscape drawings for contractor use.



What We Offer



- Full-time remote employment.

- A night-shift schedule aligned with US working hours.

- Competitive compensation based on experience and demonstrated skills.

- The opportunity to work on a variety of residential landscape and outdoor living projects across the US market.

- A collaborative team environment with established production workflows and quality standards.



How to Apply



Interested applicants should send the following to 



1. Updated CV or résumé detailing your relevant experience.

2. Portfolio of 2D landscape plans, particularly technical working drawings, planting plans, hardscape plans, and dimensioned layouts.

3. Short introduction letter explaining your experience, relevant skills, and why you would be a good fit for this position.

4. Confirmation of your availability to work US business hours on a night-shift schedule.



Please ensure your portfolio includes actual 2D landscape drafting work. We want to see how you translate design concepts into accurate, organized, and professional working drawings.



Applications without relevant landscape drafting samples may not be considered for the initial evaluation.



If you have the technical experience, attention to detail, and work ethic we’re looking for, we’d like to hear from you.



Your Haven Design Recruitment Team

title: Real Estate VA: Texting Leads + County Records Research (US Hours)
description:
About us

We're a small real estate company in Columbus, Ohio. We help families whose house is stuck: the owner passed away and nothing got transferred, or the taxes fell behind and the county sold the debt. We find these houses in county records, reach out by text, and the owner of the company handles the calls.



What you'll do

1. Answer text replies from homeowners and family members, fast. You'll follow a reply playbook, keep it short and natural, and book calls on the owner's calendar.

2. Research properties in Ohio county records: taxes, court cases, deeds and liens. You follow a written step-by-step guide.

3. Skip trace owners and family members using SmartSkip.

4. Keep everything updated in DataSift and GoHighLevel.



Schedule

Friday to Tuesday, 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM US Eastern.

That's 1:00 AM to 9:00 AM Philippine time, Saturday to Wednesday.

Weekends are our busiest reply days, so this schedule is fixed.



Pay

$5 to $7 per hour depending on experience, plus bonuses on every deal: $50 when the contract is signed and $200 when it closes.



You need

- Excellent written English that sounds natural to Americans in casual texts

- Reliable internet and a backup plan for power outages

- To be detail-oriented: one wrong name or date on a court record matters

- To reply within minutes during your shift



Big plus

- US real estate experience (wholesaling, title, skip tracing, or cold texting)

- GoHighLevel, DataSift, or SmartSkip

- Searching US county court or recorder records



How to apply

Start your application with the word "Columbus" so I know you read this.



Then answer this. We sent this text:

"Hey Maria, are you by chance related to Dorothy Wallace?"

Dorothy passed away last year. Her house is still in her name and the taxes are behind.

Maria replies: "who is this?"

Write exactly what you'd text back.



Shortlisted applicants do a short paid test before hiring.

7. Subcontractor and Supplier Management

• Maintain a prequalified list by trade, geography, licenses, insurance, safety record, bonding capability, capacity,

public-work experience and past quality.

• Seek at least three comparable quotes per material trade when feasible; document invitations, follow-up

attempts, bid leveling and reasons if fewer than three quotes are available.

APEX VETERAN CONSTRUCTION  |  AVC-SOP-EST-001  |  v1.0

• Validate license and insurance expiration and trade scope before reliance; confirm prevailing-wage and

flow-down assumptions in subcontractor pricing.

• When DBE/MWBE/small business or other participation goals apply, follow solicitation-specific outreach,

documentation, certification checks and good-faith effort procedures.





8. Post-Award Project Manager Handoff

• Within five business days of notice of award, or sooner if contract requires, hold a kickoff with estimating,

operations, superintendent, accounting and assigned project manager.

• Transfer final estimate, quantity backup, bid assumptions, exclusions, quotes, addenda, compliance matrix, wage

rates, schedule risks, subcontract commitments and approved margins.

• Build contract budget and schedule of values; assign submittals and long-lead procurement; establish RFI,

change-order, action and closeout registers.

• Do not execute changed scope without proper written authorization. Track proposal requests, notice deadlines,

cost/schedule impacts and change-order approvals.

• At closeout, confirm punch list, as-builts, O&M; manuals, warranties, final releases/lien waivers and final

cost-versus-estimate lessons learned as contractually applicable.





9. Technology, Records, and Reporting

• STACK: plan organization, calibrated digital quantities, takeoff audit trail, trade categories and exports.

• Contractor Foreman: opportunity/project reference, estimates, documents, logs, budget tracking, change orders

and reporting to extent enabled in Apex’s configuration.

• Excel / Bluebeam: bid leveling, cost modeling, drawing markup and independent checks; retain linked source files

and controlled versions.

• Keep weekly pipeline reports with estimated contract value, due dates, status, probability (if used), assigned

owner, blockers and next action. Archive final packages and proof of delivery per company retention rules and

contractual requirements.





10. Quality Control and Win-Rate Improvement

• Use independent spot checks on takeoff dimensions, extensions, formula logic, quotes and exclusions; confirm

final estimate to proposal reconciliation.

• Perform monthly win/loss review by agency, project type, bid size, procurement method and bid spread; review

losses, missed compliance, pricing decisions and market movement.

• Request bid tabulations and debriefs after losses where available. Update cost libraries with verified actuals, not

unvalidated competitor assumptions.

APEX VETERAN CONSTRUCTION  |  AVC-SOP-EST-001  |  v1.0





11. Performance Metrics and Scorecard

Metric

Definition / target

Bid submission accuracy

Bid-on-time rate

100% required documents completed; target zero nonresponsive bids caused by

internal error.

Bids accepted before deadline / bids approved for submission. Target 100%.

Win rate

Bid activity

Awards / submitted bids (also segment by agency/type/size); target [X%] to be

approved.

quality.

Estimate accuracy

Share meeting 30-business-minute internal/client acknowledgment target; report

exceptions.

Nonresponsive-bid rate

Bids ruled nonresponsive for submission defects / submitted bids; target 0%.

Total qualified open opportunity face value; report by stage and due date.

Operational quality

RFI/submittal/CO logs up to date; timely handoff; feedback from PMs/clients.

Targets are management policy proposals, not guaranteed business results. Define baseline, ownership, calculation method,

exclusions and reporting cadence before use in compensation or probation decisions.





12. Required Qualifications and Candidate Screening

• [X]+ years of public-sector construction estimating and/or managing federal, state and municipal projects;

residential/commercial experience as relevant to workload.

• Evidence of project sizes, agencies, awarded work, personal role in bids, measurable win rates and post-award

outcomes; verify representative references where authorized.

• Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS and the relevant state/local procurement rules; familiarity with public works

labor and bonding compliance.

• Demonstrable proficiency with STACK, Contractor Foreman, Excel and Bluebeam; strong communication,

document discipline and deadline ownership.



12.1 Recommended hiring process

• Structured interview on public procurement, estimate risk, schedule tradeoffs and client/subcontractor

communication.

• Timed technical task: drawing-based quantity takeoff, unit-cost build, bid leveling and sensitivity check.

• Sample public bid package review: identify omitted addenda, incomplete signatures, bond or wage errors, filing

mistakes and nonresponsive conditions.

• Reference checks with past supervisors, contractors or agency contacts who can lawfully discuss the candidate’s

work; assess professionalism and ethics.

13. Training and 30 / 60 / 90-Day Onboarding

Period

and prepare sample compliance matrix.

Days 61-90

post-award handoff simulation or real handoff.

• At days 30, 60 and 90, manager reviews accuracy, responsiveness, compliance, task ownership and documented

learning gaps; probation decisions use role-appropriate opportunities and agreed targets.





14. Confidentiality, Ethics, and Procurement Integrity

• Treat bid strategy, labor rates, vendor quotes, budgets and client/agency nonpublic information as confidential;

use access-controlled repositories and approved sharing methods.

• Disclose any financial/personal conflict, gifts, prior agency employment restriction or potential procurement

integrity issue promptly; follow agency-specific communications and blackout rules.

• Never seek or use competitors’ confidential bid information, source-selection material or improperly disclosed

government information; do not coordinate prices or bids with competitors.

• Make truthful claims about certifications, veteran ownership, self-performance, past performance and

subcontracting commitments. Escalate suspected misconduct to management before action.





15. Management Adoption Checklist

• Approve exact role boundaries and delegated authority; designate primary and backup staff.

• Confirm target geography/agencies, verified SDVOSB/VOS status, SAM registration details, and approved

• Validate Contractor Foreman data fields and whether STACK data is transferred via export/import or manual

controlled workflow.

• Review public-project legal/compliance checklist with counsel or contracts professional for each jurisdiction; issue

final SOP with approval signatures.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
The Virtual Executive Assistant provides direct administrative support to a Partner. The role’s first priority is managing incoming communications through Karbon Triage: identifying the client and relevant work, directing each matter to the right team member, and keeping items that need the Partner’s attention visible.



The assistant also supports the Partner’s calendar, meeting preparation, and routine client administration. Firm-wide administrative support may be assigned when capacity allows. The assigned Partner sets priorities and resolves competing requests.



Core responsibilities:



Karbon Triage and communication routing - 

Review incoming communications in the Partner’s Karbon Triage during assigned working hours. 

Identify the client, relevant work item, Client Manager or pod, and appropriate person to handle each request.

Attach correspondence to the relevant Karbon work item and route it to the responsible team member.

Draft replies and leave matters requiring the Partner’s judgment in their Triage, with concise context where helpful.

Recognize urgent matters, including tax deadlines, CRA notices, payroll interruptions, complaints, and time-sensitive client requests. Escalate them under firm procedures and confirm that urgent handoffs have been received.

Escalate uncertain client or work ownership to the Partner rather than guessing.

Identify requests that may require a new work item. Check with a Manager or Partner before creating one when the scope is unclear.

Triage prospective-client inquiries through the firm’s Karbon workflow.



Calendar and meeting support - 

Schedule and reschedule meetings at the Partner’s direction, coordinate with attendees, and protect designated focus time.

Prepare concise meeting briefs from relevant correspondence, documents, and outstanding items.

Draft agendas and suggested questions for selected meetings.

Turn meeting notes and transcripts into organized drafts for the Partner’s review.



Routine client administration - 

Communicate with clients about scheduling, document requests, and other routine administrative matters.

Send approved document-request lists and follow up on missing items.

Draft administrative correspondence. After training, send routine replies on the Partner’s behalf within agreed guidelines.

Make or answer specific client calls when requested and given appropriate guidance.



Procedures and additional support - 

Help maintain the team, client-ownership, and communication-routing resources needed to perform the role accurately.

Document recurring procedures as they are learned or improved.

Assist other team members with administrative work when the Partner’s priorities and Triage responsibilities are covered.



Authority and boundaries - 

The assistant may make routine administrative decisions within documented procedures and delegated authority. Accounting, tax, assurance, pricing, engagement-scope, and other professional judgments remain with the appropriate team member. Unclear or sensitive matters are escalated.



The initial role does not include personal administration for a Partner, work for the Partner’s other businesses or community roles, general ownership of every commitment arising from meetings and
s, independent authority to decline meeting requests, or routine phone coverage. Some of these responsibilities may be considered as the role develops.



Experience and capabilities:



Required - 

Administrative or executive-support experience in an accounting, legal, financial-advice, insurance-advice, or comparable professional-services environment.

Excellent written and spoken English and a professional manner with clients and colleagues.

Strong organization, attention to detail, and judgment when prioritizing incoming requests.

The ability to recognize urgency, handle confidential information carefully, and seek direction when ownership or authority is unclear.

Confidence learning new software and following documented processes.

A reliable remote-work setup and availability for an agreed schedule with regular Saskatchewan team overlap.



Valuable, but not required - 

Experience with Karbon, particularly Triage, contacts, work items, and team assignments.

Experience with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and Teams Calling.

Experience with Krisp, an AI meeting assistant used to capture calls, produce transcripts, and support meeting notes and follow-up documentation.

Experience preparing executive meeting briefs and coordinating administrative work across a client-service team.



Measures of success - 

Early success means client communications are consistently linked to the correct work and routed to the correct person; urgent matters reach someone who can act; the Partner’s Triage contains the items that truly need their attention; and meetings are scheduled and prepared with minimal rework.



We would assess this through samples of routing and tagging accuracy, urgent handoffs, avoidable reassignments, and feedback from the Partner and receiving team members. Specific response-time expectations will be set once the working schedule and Saskatchewan office coverage are agreed.

title: Shopify Paid Funnel / CRO Specialist
description:
I run a small Shopify brand and need help fixing a paid-traffic conversion problem.



My Meta ads are getting clicks and landing page views, but the traffic is not turning into profitable purchases consistently.



I am not looking for a general Shopify VA, a full store redesign, or someone who only runs Meta campaigns.



I need someone who can look at the full post-click buying path:



- Meta ad results

- Shopify product page / landing page

- mobile buying experience

- offer clarity

- Add to Cart ? Checkout flow

- Microsoft Clarity or session recordings

- basic Meta + Shopify tracking checks



The diagnosis is already partly documented. I have a handoff document showing what has been tested, what has been fixed, and what still needs validation.



Your job would be to:



1. Review the current funnel handoff document.

2. Review the current Shopify product page on mobile.

3. Look at the latest Meta ad results.

4. Identify the single highest-probability remaining blocker.

5. Recommend the smallest fix before the next paid ad test.

6. Help implement or clearly direct that fix.

7. Set up or help review one clean ad test to measure whether the fix worked.



This is not a “make the site look nicer” job.



The goal is to answer:



Why are people clicking the ads but not buying profitably?



Experience with Shopify CRO, product page optimization, Meta Ads, and Microsoft Clarity is important.



Conversion copywriting experience is a plus, but I am not looking for a generic copywriter. I need someone who understands paid traffic funnels and buyer behavior.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Please apply only if you have experience with at least some of the following:



- Shopify product page optimization

- Conversion rate optimization / CRO

- Meta Ads performance review

- Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or session recording tools

- Mobile-first ecommerce pages

- Cart / checkout friction diagnosis

- Landing page or PDP conversion improvement

- DTC or ecommerce brands



TO APPLY

Please answer these questions:



1. Tell me about one Shopify or ecommerce brand where paid traffic was getting clicks but not enough purchases. What did you find and what did you fix?



2. What metrics would you look at first if Meta ads are getting clicks and landing page views, but purchases are weak?



3. How would you diagnose whether the issue is:

- page / offer clarity

- cart / checkout friction

- tracking

- audience quality

- creative creating curiosity but not purchase intent



4. Have you used Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or another session recording tool? If yes, how do you use it?



5. Please share your hourly rate or proposed project rate.

title: Pricing Analyst (Government Contracts)
description:
THE ROLE

The Pricing Analyst maximizes company profitability by building competitive, compliant pricing based on data analysis, market trends, and service delivery costs. You'll work with Procurement, Operations, Finance, and Leadership to make sure every price is accurate, defensible, and backed by data.



This role is built for someone who already knows security or service-industry pricing in a government contracting environment and needs little to no training.



Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Central Time (US)

Location: Fully remote



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Receive and interpret requests for quotations, solicitations, contracts, and other formats, and translate them into pricing models

- Build and manage pricing requests, proposals, discounts, and commercial offers

- Develop labor-based pricing, including wage rates, fringe benefits, burdens, overhead, and profit

- Provide pricing support to Procurement and Business Development, and communicate rate structures clearly and confidently to stakeholders

- Troubleshoot pricing discrepancies using rate rules and logical analysis

- Update and maintain pricing and cost data and assumptions, including market research and competitor comparisons

- Track pricing performance and identify opportunities to improve margins and win rates

- Coordinate with other departments to validate pricing information

- Make sure pricing practices follow company policy, business guidelines, and contract requirements

- Handle confidential pricing and cost data with discretion



WHAT YOU BRING



Required: Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field (or 4 additional years of directly related experience in place of a degree)

- 3+ years of pricing, costing, or financial analysis experience

- Experience in the security industry or a service-based industry (e.g., security, janitorial, facilities, staffing, or other labor-driven services)

- Government contracting (GovCon) pricing experience, including pricing submitted on federal RFQs/RFPs



Required: GovCon Pricing Skills

- Building fully burdened hourly bill rates from the ground up: base wage, fringe, health & welfare, payroll taxes (FICA, FUTA, SUTA), workers' compensation, insurance, overhead, G&A, and profit

- Pricing to Service Contract Act (SCA) wage determinations, including locating the correct wage determination on 

- Pricing base and option years, including wage escalation

- Pricing labor covered by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA)

- Working knowledge of the FAR as it applies to pricing (e.g., price reasonableness, price realism, lowest-price-technically-acceptable vs. best-value awards)

- Reading a solicitation's pricing instructions and price schedule (CLINs) and completing it accurately



Required: Tools & Skills

- Advanced Excel: complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and multi-scenario pricing models (2+ years)

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, defensible recommendations

- Excellent attention to detail, because pricing errors cost contracts

- Highly collaborative, with strong communication and interpersonal skills

- Ability to work independently with little to no training

- Ability to handle confidential pricing and cost data with discretion

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, private home workspace

- Must pass a pre-employment background check



HIGHLY PREFERRED

- Security services pricing specifically (armed/unarmed officer posts, supervisory coverage, post hours)

- GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) pricing experience

- Price-to-win and competitor pricing analysis

- Experience with pricing or market-intelligence tools (e.g., GovWin, HigherGov, ProPricer)

- NCMA certification (CFCM or CPCM)



Interview Note: Finalists will complete a short pricing exercise.



WHY JOIN US

- Competitive salary, based on experience

- Fully remote, Monday to Friday schedule, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM CST

- A direct impact on contract wins and company profitability at a growing federal contractor



HOW TO APPLY

Please include short answers to these questions in your application:

1. Do you have pricing experience in the security industry or another service-based industry?

2. Have you priced federal government contracts (RFQs, RFPs, task orders)?

3. Have you built fully burdened hourly bill rates using Service Contract Act (SCA) wage determinations?

4. Briefly list the cost elements you include when building a fully burdened hourly rate.

title: Short-Form Video Clipper / Editor (YouTube Shorts) – Ongoing
description:
We run a family YouTube channel and post long-form horizontal videos regularly. We’re looking for a skilled clipper and editor to turn those videos into engaging vertical short-form clips (15–60 seconds each) for YouTube Shorts and other platforms.



This is an ongoing role with a minimum of 5 clips per week, and room to grow for the right person.



What you’ll do



Watch our long-form videos and pick out the best moments for Shorts: the funniest, most emotional, surprising or engaging parts that grab attention fast and hold it

Cut each moment into a tight clip of 15–60 seconds with a strong hook in the first few seconds

Convert horizontal footage to vertical (9:16), keeping framing clean and the right person in frame

Reframe frame by frame when needed so whoever is talking or the main action is always properly centered

Deliver clips on a consistent weekly schedule



What matters most



A great eye for moments. You can tell what will perform as a Short and what won’t. This is the most important part of the job.

Clean vertical framing. You take the time to keep speakers and action properly framed, even if that means adjusting keyframes manually instead of relying on auto-reframe.



Requirements



Proven experience editing short-form vertical content (YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Reels)

title: Lead Generation & Vendor Partnerships VA — Bay Area Events
description:
Premier Events & Staff is hiring a proactive, organized Virtual Assistant to help build a real revenue pipeline in the San Francisco Bay Area, including San Jose, Walnut Creek, Napa, Palo Alto, and surrounding communities.



Learn more about Premier Events & Staff: 



This is a results-driven business-development role, not passive data entry or generic admin work. Your job is to research, organize, contact, and follow up with people and businesses that can create future event revenue for Premier.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING



1. Corporate, Referral & Lead Prospecting — Primary Focus



Research Bay Area companies and decision-makers who may need corporate events, holiday parties, catering, staffing, rentals, AV, event coordination, or related services.



You will identify and verify contacts such as HR leaders, People Operations teams, office managers, executive assistants, marketing and event leaders, founders, operations leaders, estate managers, property managers, venue managers, luxury realtors, concierge teams, and event planners.



Using Premier-approved
 accounts and scripts, you will send personalized outreach, manage follow-ups, keep records organized, and flag real event opportunities for our sales team.



2. Vendor Master Roster & Strategic Partnerships — Second Revenue Path



Build and maintain Premier’s Bay Area vendor master sheet across catering, private chefs, food trucks, rentals, AV, lighting, staging, DJs, entertainment, photographers, florists, decorators, transportation, cleaning, venues, and related event services.



For each qualified vendor or relationship source, you will record contact information, services, service area, website, source URL, pricing or rate sheets when available, minimums, communication history, and next follow-up date.



This is where the role can “double dip.” A vendor, venue, estate manager, caterer, or property manager may be a subcontractor that helps us fulfill events, a referral source that can send us business, a potential Premier client, or all three. You must recognize that opportunity, tag it correctly, and keep the relationship moving.



PAID 14-DAY TRIAL



This is a paid role at $8/hour, 20 hours per week, for an initial 14-day trial. We expect approximately four focused hours per weekday, with some Pacific Time overlap.



By Day 7, expected results include:

- 75 new qualified, non-duplicate corporate or referral prospects

- 25 qualified Bay Area vendor or strategic-partner records

- At least 40 personalized
 outreach actions or purposeful follow-ups

- A clean pipeline with source URLs, contact details, relevance, status, last activity, and next follow-up date



By Day 14, expected results include:

- 150–200 qualified corporate or referral prospects

- At least 40 vendor or strategic-partner records

- 80–120 documented personalized
 outreach actions and follow-ups

- A shortlist of strong vendor partners, referral sources, warm prospects, and emerging event opportunities

- Accurate, organized records with no fabricated information or duplicate contacts



WHAT WE NEED



You should have experience with lead generation, appointment setting, vendor sourcing, partnership outreach, sales support, or business-development assistance.



You must write clear professional English, be comfortable using Google Sheets and/or CRMs, know how to research and verify business information, and be reliable with daily
 outreach and follow-up.



IMPORTANT RULES



Use only Premier-approved
 accounts, scripts, systems, and databases. Do not fabricate information, send mass spam, negotiate contracts, quote binding prices, promise bookings, or commit Premier to services without management approval. Respect opt-outs and keep all company information confidential.



TO APPLY



Please answer these three questions:



1. What tools have you used to research businesses and verify
 addresses?

2. Have you personally handled B2B cold

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Content Manager
description:
# Hiring: Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Content Manager



**Remote | Part-Time | $60–$100 USD per week | Long-Term Opportunity**



We are looking for a talented, reliable and creative short-form video editor to help grow our TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts accounts.



We work with social media content reward campaigns, turning approved long-form videos into highly engaging short-form content.



**We are NOT looking for someone who simply cuts long videos into shorter videos.**



We need someone who understands viral content, audience retention, engaging hooks and professional editing.



### Your Responsibilities



- Review long-form videos and select the most engaging moments.

- Produce approximately 20 high-quality short-form videos per week.

- Create attention-grabbing on-screen hooks within the first 1–2 seconds.

- Add dynamic, accurate subtitles with highlighted keywords.

- Use zooms, transitions, sound effects and B-roll where appropriate.

- Ensure clips flow naturally and keep viewers watching.

- Follow individual campaign requirements, including approved footage, required tags and end screens.

- Write engaging, platform-specific captions, descriptions and hashtags.

- Organise finished clips and prepare content for scheduling through Buffer.

- Deliver all completed work by Sunday each week.

- Communicate proactively and meet agreed deadlines.



### Requirements



- Proven experience editing TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

- Strong understanding of viral hooks and viewer retention.

- Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar editing software.

- Excellent written English.

- Reliable internet and communication.

- Ability to work independently.

- Experience using Buffer or similar scheduling software is a bonus.

- Familiarity with Whop Content Rewards is a bonus.



### Payment



Starting budget: **$60–$100 per week**, depending on experience, quality and agreed responsibilities.



Approximately 20 completed videos per week.



This is an ongoing opportunity with the potential for increased pay and responsibilities as the business grows.



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. A portfolio showing your three best short-form video edits.

2. Examples featuring strong hooks, animated captions and engaging editing.

title: Video Editor (AI Ads & Direct Response)
description:
About Maia Holdings



Maia Holdings is a holding company that owns and scales direct-response health and wellness brands. We create performance-driven advertising creatives designed to capture attention, communicate product value, and convert viewers into customers.



We’re looking for a skilled Video Editor with hands-on experience creating AI-powered advertisements who understands both creative execution and direct-response marketing. You’ll produce engaging AI animation ads, AI UGC ads, and AI-generated song ads that help drive measurable advertising results.



Key Responsibilities



Create high-quality AI animation ads, including character-based and Pixar-style animation, with compelling hooks, product messaging, and clear calls to action.



Produce realistic AI UGC ads featuring AI avatars or talking heads with natural delivery, accurate lip-syncing, and convincing expressions.



Develop AI song and jingle ads using AI music-generation tools, incorporating persuasive lyrics that communicate product benefits and encourage action.



Edit short-form, direct-response video ads optimized for paid advertising campaigns.



Build compelling openings that capture attention within the first three seconds and maintain viewer engagement through effective pacing, storytelling, captions, and transitions.



Collaborate with the creative and marketing teams to develop concepts, test creative variations, and improve ad performance.



Incorporate feedback and deliver revisions quickly while maintaining high production standards.



Ensure captions and on-screen text are clear, accurate, and compliant with applicable advertising guidelines, particularly for health, wellness, and supplement products.



Use performance data and feedback to identify opportunities to improve hooks, audience retention, click-through rates, and conversions.



Organize projects, submit deliverables, and communicate progress through ClickUp and other team collaboration tools.



Required Qualifications



All four requirements below are mandatory. Applicants must demonstrate each through actual work samples.



AI Animation Ads: At least one completed AI-generated animation advertisement featuring characters or motion animation that was used as a paid ad. The sample must demonstrate a clear hook, product message, and CTA.



AI UGC Ads: At least one completed AI UGC advertisement featuring an AI avatar or talking head with realistic visuals, natural delivery, and clean lip-syncing.



AI Song Ads: At least one completed advertisement built around an AI-generated song or jingle, with persuasive lyrics that sell a product or communicate a compelling offer.



Direct-Response Advertising: A solid understanding of performance marketing, including how hooks capture attention, how ads maintain viewer engagement, how CTAs drive action, and how metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, and ROAS are used to evaluate performance.



Important: Applicants who cannot demonstrate all four required qualifications will not proceed to the next stage.

Higgsfield



HeyGen



Suno

ElevenLabs

Familiarity with 
 for reviewing creative work and ClickUp for project management.

What We're Looking For



We want an editor who combines creativity with a performance-driven mindset. You should be able to explain not just how an ad looks, but why it works.



You understand how to:



Create attention-grabbing hooks that stop viewers from scrolling.



Maintain engagement through effective pacing, storytelling, and visual changes.



Make AI-generated content feel realistic, polished, and natural.



Turn product features and benefits into persuasive advertising.



Guide viewers toward a clear CTA.



Evaluate ad performance and use results to inform future creative decisions.



We value editors who take ownership of their work, communicate clearly, meet deadlines, and continuously improve their creative output.



Application Requirements

Your portfolio or links to completed advertisements.

AI animation advertisement

title: Roofing Production Coordinator
description:
Job Location: Remote

Office Location: Woodland Hills, CA 91364

Job Type: Full-Time

Salary Range: $750-$850 monthly

Typical Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM



About Us

At Quality Roofing Specialists, we believe that a roof is more than just a structure—it’s protection, trust, and peace of mind. Our mission is simple: With passion and precision, we craft top-quality roofs that enhance homes, build trust, and deliver lasting protection. As a growing company, we have set a bold vision to protect 6,000 homes with quality roofing over the next 10 years.

 

We are building a team of dedicated professionals who align with our core values:

✅ Integrity – We do what’s right, always.

✅ Respect – We treat clients and teammates with kindness and professionalism.

✅ Discipline – We stay focused, committed, and consistent in our work.

✅ Accountability – We take ownership of our responsibilities and results.

✅ Transparency – We communicate openly and honestly.

✅ Alignment – We work together toward our shared vision and goals.

✅ Results-Orientation – We strive for excellence and measurable success.



Position Overview

The Roofing Production Coordinator supports the Production Manager by coordinating the administrative and logistical processes that move roofing projects from sold-job intake through pre-production, installation, inspections, and completion.

This person serves as a central communication and coordination point between Sales, B2B clients, the Production Manager, field teams, and other stakeholders.

The primary objective is to keep every project organized, properly documented, on track, and moving forward without unnecessary delays.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of responsibilities, manages priorities independently, communicates proactively, and maintains high standards of accuracy and follow-through.

 

Key Responsibilities

1. Production Coordination & Project Management

• Coordinate roofing projects from sold-job intake through installation and completion.

• Ensure job information is complete, accurate, and properly organized before production begins.

• Maintain clear project stages and accurate records within the CRM and company production boards.

• Track outstanding requirements, contracts, documentation, scheduling needs, and project milestones.

• Proactively identify potential delays, missing information, and production issues, escalating them to the Production Manager when necessary.

2. Documentation & Administrative Accuracy

• Review project descriptions, roof measurements, property details, scope information, and jobsite requirements for accuracy and completeness.

• Coordinate required permits, certifications, smoke detector forms, inspection records, and other project documentation.

• Maintain organized digital records and ensure the latest approved documents are readily accessible to the team.

• Document important decisions, updates, and commitments from communications and ensure project records remain current.

3. Communication & Stakeholder Coordination

• Maintain clear, professional, and timely communication with Sales, B2B clients, the Production Manager, field crews, and other stakeholders.

• Coordinate project information and updates through WhatsApp, CRM systems, and other company communication channels.

• Follow up consistently on outstanding requests, inspection requirements, approvals, and client responsibilities.

• Communicate problems early, provide accurate updates, and ensure unresolved issues reach the appropriate person.

4. Weather, Inspections & Risk Management

• Monitor weather forecasts and coordinate weather-related updates and protective measures for active roofing projects.

• Help ensure properties are appropriately protected against potential rain exposure, including coordinating tarping when needed.

• Track inspection schedules, required documentation, inspection results, and corrective actions.

• Ensure inspection outcomes are communicated promptly and failed inspections are escalated for resolution.

• Anticipate scheduling and documentation risks that could affect project timelines, property protection, or customer satisfaction.

5. Process Improvement & Accountability

• Maintain consistent production coordination procedures and ensure established workflow stages are followed.

• Identify opportunities to improve CRM accuracy, communication, documentation, scheduling, and follow-up systems.

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.

• Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and follow tasks through to completion without constant supervision.

Qualifications & Skills

Required Qualifications

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.

• Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to anticipate potential issues.

• Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and escalate concerns appropriately.

• Strong accountability, time management, and task-management skills.

• Proficiency with CRM systems, spreadsheets,
, WhatsApp, and digital documentation.

• Ability to learn new software, follow established procedures, and maintain accurate records.

• Professionalism when communicating with clients, vendors, coworkers, and management.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience in roofing, construction, remodeling, or a related industry.

• Experience in production coordination, project coordination, construction administration, or operations support.

• Familiarity with roofing terminology, roof measurements, permits, inspections, and construction documentation.

• Experience with EagleView, Roofr, CRM platforms, project management software, or construction scheduling tools.

• Experience coordinating multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is naturally organized, dependable, and driven to ensure things get done correctly.

The ideal candidate:

• Thinks ahead: Identifies missing information, scheduling conflicts, and potential problems before they cause delays.

• Follows through: Tracks commitments and outstanding tasks until they are resolved.

• Communicates proactively: Keeps the right people informed and does not wait for others to ask for updates.

• Pays attention to detail: Understands that small administrative errors can create significant production problems.

• Takes ownership: Accepts responsibility for results and focuses on solutions rather than excuses.

• Manages priorities effectively: Maintains control of multiple active projects without losing track of important details.

• Works systematically: Uses checklists, CRM records, calendars, and communication tools to create consistency.

• Embraces technology: Learns new systems and uses digital tools to improve efficiency and accuracy.

• Remains composed under pressure: Adapts to changing schedules, weather conditions, and unexpected production challenges.

This is not a passive administrative position. We need someone who actively monitors project progress, anticipates what needs to happen next, and takes responsibility for ensuring that important tasks are completed on time.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by the coordinator's ability to maintain organized, accurate, and efficient production operations.



Key performance indicators include:

• Accuracy and completeness of job information and CRM records.

• Consistent compliance with required production stages and procedures.

• Timely coordination of documentation, inspections, and project requirements.

• Proactive weather monitoring and communication.

• Effective follow-up on outstanding tasks and stalled projects.

• Clear communication with clients and internal team members.

• Reduced avoidable delays caused by missed details, incomplete paperwork, or poor coordination.

• Consistent accountability and reliable execution of responsibilities.



How to Apply

If you are highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and committed to ensuring projects move forward efficiently, we encourage you to apply.

Please submit your resume and a brief video describing your relevant experience in project coordination, construction administration, CRM management, or operations support.

title: ECOMMERCE BOOKKEEPER (QUICKBOOKS + SHOPIFY) FOR 7-FIGURE DTC SUPPLEMENT BRAND - PART-TIME WITH PATH TO FULL-TIME
description:
We're a 7-figure US DTC supplement brand selling on Shopify and Amazon. We spend six figures a month on ads, ship physical inventory, and run subscriptions . What we need is the person who keeps the books clean every single week, so the numbers we make decisions on are numbers we can trust.



This starts part-time, about two days a week. The plan is to grow it into a full-time finance role for the right person. If you're the kind of bookkeeper who finds the finances that doesn't match and won't let it go, keep reading.



HARD REQUIREMENTS (you must meet all of these)

- 2+ years doing bookkeeping for ecommerce or DTC brands. Not general small business, not a single retail store

- Strong in QuickBooks Online. Reconciliations, rules, classes, journal entries, month-end close

- You have reconciled Shopify payouts before and understand what's inside one: gross sales, refunds, discounts, fees, chargebacks, reserves

- You understand inventory and COGS: landed cost, inventory as an asset, expensing cost when the product sells

- Fluent written English. Your questions and reports need to be clear without a follow-up call

- Reliable and consistent. Books get done on schedule, every week, without being chased



Applications from people without ecommerce bookkeeping experience will be discarded.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Weekly

- Categorize and reconcile all bank, credit card and PayPal transactions in QuickBooks

- Reconcile Shopify payouts and Amazon settlements back to the bank deposits

- Tag every expense to the right category in our internal finance dashboard. Your goal is zero untagged items each week

- Prepare bills for payment: supplier invoices, agency invoices, contractor pay. You prepare it, the founder approves and pays

- Track refunds and chargebacks so we can see exactly what they cost us



Monthly

- Close the books by the 10th: every account reconciled, P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement done

- Keep COGS accurate with landed cost per unit (product, freight, duties, fulfillment)

- Match our profit dashboard numbers to QuickBooks and explain any difference

- Review software and subscriptions and flag anything unused or duplicated

- Send a one-page summary each month: the numbers, what changed, and anything that looks off



Ongoing

- Track sales tax obligations by state and keep filings on schedule

- Collect contractor tax forms (W-8BEN / W-9)

- Hand our CPA a clean year-end package



TOOLS

QuickBooks Online, Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Sellerboard, TrueProfit, Mercury (bank), PayPal, Google Sheets. AI tools are a plus. If you use ChatGPT or Claude to speed up your work, tell us how.



BONUS SKILLS

- QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification

- Experience with supplement, beauty or other consumable brands with subscriptions

- Sales tax tools (TaxJar, Avalara, Shopify Tax)

- Cash flow forecasting, or contribution margin by product



THE ROLE GROWS

Part-time to start. Once the books are clean and closing on time, this role grows into cash flow forecasting, profit by product, and budget vs actual, and the hours grow with it, up to full-time. We also run a second brand that will need the same setup later.



WHO WE WANT

You're detail-obsessed and you can't leave numbers that don't match. You ask questions when something doesn't make sense instead of guessing or plugging it. You work independently, show up on schedule, and tell us early when something is behind.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with "Clean Books." Applications without it are not reviewed.

2. Tell us which ecommerce brands you've done bookkeeping for (no names needed): what they sold, roughly their monthly revenue, and which platforms they used.

3. In 3-5 sentences, explain how you reconcile a Shopify payout to the bank deposit.

4. Tell us your QuickBooks experience in years and whether you're ProAdvisor certified.

5. How many hours a week are you available right now, and would you want full-time later?
