title: Fractional Multi-Entity Accountant / Accounting Specialist
description:
Work Arrangement: Part-Time / Fractional Independent Contractor

Location: Philippines – Metro Manila preferred

Initial Workload: Approximately 8–12 hours per week; up to 45 hours per month included in base engagement

Reporting: Operationally to Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator; financial reporting and escalation directly to Founder/CEO

Initial Engagement: 90-day evaluation period



Position Overview



We are seeking a highly organized, trustworthy and detail-oriented accountant to support the accounting operations of several U.S.-based businesses, including a growing travel and hospitality business and a professional services firm.



This is not a traditional full-time accounting position and is not intended to be a purely transactional bookkeeping role.



The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate books and records, performing reconciliations, supporting accounts payable and receivable processes, tracking commissions and business expenses, preparing management reports, and maintaining clear financial records across multiple business entities.



The position requires exceptional discretion and confidentiality because the accountant will have access to sensitive business and financial information.



The role is initially expected to require approximately 8–12 hours per week, with additional hours during month-end, year-end or periods of increased activity.



Primary Responsibilities

Accounting and Reconciliation

Maintain accurate accounting records for multiple business entities.

Reconcile bank, credit card and designated payment-platform accounts.

Review and categorize business expenses.

Identify discrepancies, duplicates, missing transactions and unusual activity.

Maintain supporting documentation for transactions.

Assist with intercompany and related-entity reconciliations when required.

Maintain accurate accounts payable and accounts receivable records.

Prepare recurring journal entries and month-end adjustments as appropriate.

Monthly Close and Management Reporting



Support a disciplined monthly close process and prepare a monthly management package that includes, as applicable:



Profit and loss statement

Balance sheet

Cash position

Accounts receivable

Accounts payable

Budget versus actual results

Major expense variances

Commission receivables

Contractor and payroll expense reconciliation

Business-unit or project profitability

Outstanding accounting issues

90-day cash-flow outlook



The accountant should be capable of identifying and explaining significant discrepancies rather than simply producing reports.



Travel Business Accounting



For Travel Hike & Eat and related travel operations:



Track travel supplier and agency commissions.

Reconcile Fora and other supplier commission statements.

Track commission receivables.

Assist with traveler and trip payment reconciliation when required.

Maintain trip-level revenue and expense accounting.

Prepare trip-level profitability reports.

Track deposits, refunds and vendor payments.

Assist with financial reconciliation of group trips and optional excursions.

Support calculation of gross profit and employee incentive pools when applicable.

Payroll, Contractor and Vendor Support

Reconcile EOR and contractor invoices.

Track recurring vendors and business expenses.

Review supporting documentation for reimbursements.

Assist with contractor payment records.

Maintain accounting records supporting payroll and outside service providers.

Prepare records required by external tax professionals and CPAs.

Multi-Entity Responsibilities



The accountant may support multiple businesses under common ownership.



Each entity must be maintained independently with clear separation of:



Bank accounts

Expenses

Revenue

Contracts

Vendor payments

Accounting records

Financial reporting



The accountant must demonstrate an understanding of maintaining proper entity separation and avoiding inappropriate commingling of business transactions.



Financial Controls



This position is an accounting and reporting role and does not carry independent authority to move company funds.



Unless expressly authorized by the Founder/CEO, the accountant will not:



Approve payments

Execute wires or transfers

Add or modify banking beneficiaries

Change banking instructions

Sign checks

Open or close financial accounts

Obtain credit

Commit a company to financial obligations

Make investments

Transfer funds between entities



The accountant may prepare payments or supporting documentation for review when specifically authorized, but final financial authorization remains with the Founder/CEO.



Confidentiality and Information Security



This position requires a high degree of trust.



The successful candidate must agree to strict confidentiality and data-security requirements, including:



Use of company-approved systems and accounts.

Multi-factor authentication on required systems.

No sharing of usernames, passwords or credentials.

No subcontracting of assigned work.

No unauthorized copying or downloading of company financial information.

No storage of sensitive company data on personal devices or personal cloud-storage accounts.

Use of company-provided or company-approved equipment for sensitive financial work.

Immediate reporting of suspected security i
.

Return or deletion of company information upon termination as directed.

Continued confidentiality obligations after the engagement ends.



Access to financial systems will be provided according to the principle of least privilege and may be expanded as responsibilities develop.



Qualifications



Preferred candidates should have:



Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a closely related field.

Approximately 3–5 years of relevant accounting experience.

Strong practical bookkeeping and reconciliation experience.

Experience supporting multiple entities, business units or clients.

Strong knowledge of general ledger accounting.

Experience preparing monthly financial statements.

Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.

Experience with QuickBooks Online or similar accounting platforms.

Strong written and spoken English.

Exceptional attention to detail.

Ability to work independently and meet recurring deadlines.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Demonstrated discretion handling confidential financial information.

Preferred Experience



Additional consideration will be given to candidates with experience in one or more of the following:



U.S.-based businesses

U.S. GAAP accounting environments

Professional services firms

Travel agencies, hospitality or tourism businesses

Commission accounting

Multi-entity accounting

Project or job-cost accounting

International contractors or EOR providers

Wise or other international payment platforms

QuickBooks Online

Management reporting

Cash-flow forecasting



CPA licensure is welcome but is not required.



We place greater value on strong operational accounting ability, accuracy, judgment and reliability than on credentials alone.



Working Relationship



The accountant will work closely with the Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator for documentation, scheduling and workflow coordination.



The accountant will have direct access to the Founder/CEO for financial reporting and must independently escalate:



Material discrepancies

Unusual transactions

Suspected fraud

Internal-control weaknesses

Repeated missing documentation

Significant accounting errors

Potential conflicts of interest

Security concerns

Compensation



Initial compensation is structured as a monthly fractional retainer.



Base Retainer: ₱22,000 per month



The retainer includes up to 45 hours of accounting services per month.



Pre-approved work beyond 45 hours will be compensated at ₱500 per hour.



Additional work beyond 65 total hours in a month requires specific approval from the Founder/CEO.



The engagement will initially operate under a 90-day evaluation period.



A discretionary performance bonus may be considered based upon accuracy, timeliness, reporting quality, reliability and overall contribution.



Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured primarily by:



Accuracy of accounting records

Timely completion of reconciliations

Timely month-end close

Quality of financial reporting

Identification and resolution of discrepancies

Maintenance of proper entity separation

Responsiveness

Organization and documentation

Security and confidentiality

Reduction in the accounting administrative burden placed on management



The objective of this role is not simply to record transactions. The accountant should help management maintain reliable financial information from which sound business decisions can be made.

title: Experienced Bookkeeper / Staff Accountant
description:
We're looking for an experienced bookkeeper or staff accountant to join a small accounting practice and take ownership of day-to-day client bookkeeping work. This is a real accounting role — not a general VA position — and we're looking for someone who can work independently, apply solid accounting judgment, and deliver clean, well-reviewed work. If you have a strong bookkeeping background and enjoy working through a client file from start to finish, this could be a great fit.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Complete weekly transaction categorization and coding in QuickBooks Online, including matching receipts and preparing expense reports for owner review.

- Independently perform bank and credit card reconciliations across client accounts, investigate discrepancies, resolve routine issues, and bring a clear summary of anything that needs higher-level review.

- Support month-end close, including balance sheet account review, P&L reasonableness review, and basic adjusting journal entry preparation.

- Self-review your own work before submitting — identify exceptions, note where judgment was used, and flag only the items that genuinely require the owner's approval.

- Track and follow up on outstanding client documents needed to keep bookkeeping workflows moving, such as receipts, statements, and source records.

- Support the billing cycle through invoice preparation and payment follow-up, within defined scope and without authority to change pricing or approve adjustments.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- 5+ years of hands-on bookkeeping or accounting experience — this is a firm requirement for this role.

- Prior experience at a bookkeeping firm, CPA firm, CAS practice, or similar environment where you've worked across multiple client files is strongly preferred.

- Strong QuickBooks Online experience well beyond basic navigation — you should be comfortable using it daily across the full range of bookkeeping tasks.

- The ability to investigate an issue, apply reasonable accounting judgment, and come back with a recommended treatment rather than simply flagging everything for review.

- Solid understanding of accounting fundamentals — debits and credits, reconciliation logic, transaction categorization, and basic financial statement review.

- Experience with clean-up bookkeeping or identifying unusual and incorrect balances is a plus.

- Strong attention to detail, good self-review habits, and a reliable, organized approach to managing client files.

- Strong written and spoken English — you'll be communicating directly with the owner to report on status, ask questions, and summarize your work.

- Discretion with confidential financial data is essential.



SCHEDULE & PAY



- Full-time: 40 hours per week

- Hours: 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM Pacific Time

BENEFITS

title: Hiring: Creative Short-Form Video Editor
description:
About Me



Hey! I'm Tyler Ryan Hall, a life coach, speaker, and content creator building a personal brand around one central idea: Becoming.



My content documents the pursuit of a bigger, more fulfilling life through travel, fitness, personal growth, extraordinary experiences, and everyday moments.

I'm looking for a creative editor who wants to help bring these stories to life.



Who I'm Looking For:



I'm not looking for someone who simply follows instructions and adds captions.



I'm looking for someone with a creative eye.



Someone who understands storytelling, can recognize compelling moments in raw footage, and knows how to transform clips into videos people genuinely want to watch.



I'll provide creative direction, story outlines, voiceovers, and reference material. But I want you to bring your own ideas and artistic instincts to the editing process.



Responsibilities



Edit short-form vertical videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



Create engaging hooks, thoughtful pacing, and compelling visual storytelling.



Incorporate B-roll, music, captions, and sound design.



Make independent creative decisions while maintaining a consistent brand style.



Organize footage and editable project files.



Collaborate on revisions and meet agreed delivery dates.



What Matters Most



A strong sense of storytelling and emotional pacing.



Excellent taste and attention to detail.



Creative initiative and problem-solving.



Willingness to collaborate, experiment, and receive feedback.



Reliability and clear communication.



Interest in lifestyle, travel, documentary-style, or personal development content.



Compensation and Workflow



The initial budget is $400 USD per month for up to 25 standard short-form edits, with typical runtimes of 30–90 seconds.



More complex edits may be scoped separately. We will agree on deliverables, revision limits, turnaround times, and working expectations before beginning.



My intention is to build a long-term relationship, with opportunities to expand our collaboration and compensation as the brand grows.



Application Process



Please submit:



A link to your portfolio featuring three short-form edits you're particularly proud of.



A brief introduction explaining your creative approach.



Your preferred editing software.



Your typical turnaround time for a 60-second video.



Confirmation that the proposed monthly scope and budget work for you.

Following the interviews, I'll narrow the applicant pool to a small group of finalists who will be invited to complete a short editing audition using footage from my Wheel of Fortune travel series.



The goal is to find someone whose creative vision, communication style, and storytelling instincts align with the direction I'm building.

title: Paid Media Manager - Meta & Google Ads
description:
Paid Media Manager — Meta & Google Ads, Fashion

Remote · Part-time · Independent Contractor

 

Read this first

This role is for someone who has run paid ads for clothing or fashion brands, and who knows how to sell clothing without sales, discounts, countdowns or urgency. If your results have come from promotions, or your experience is mainly lead generation, coaching or dropshipping, this role won't be a fit, and we'd rather say so now.

 

About us

Cocopiña makes feminine clothing for women who love to travel. We're a small US brand and we sell directly to our customers. We shoot all of our own photography and video, so there is a large, organized library to advertise with.

 

Our ads never lead with a discount or a deadline. The ad has to show why the piece is worth buying: the fabric, the fit on a real body, how it's made, what it does across a full day. Reading whether an ad does that is the core of this job.

 

The job

You run our ad accounts and make them better. You d
 what runs, build and launch the ads, replace what has stopped working, and find what is holding performance back.

 

The heart of it is reading creative. You look at how individual ads performed and explain what caused the difference: the hook, the format, the angle, the line, what the frame shows. Then you turn that into a recommendation for what we should run and what we should make next.

 

You won't produce creative or work with influencers. We do want your creative input: angles worth trying, what a hook is missing, what we should shoot next.

 

Tools and process

Our tools are connected, and automated processes pull and analyze account data, including an AI analysis that runs weekly. Part of this job is refining them, and building the systems that keep performance improving rather than relying on anyone's memory of what worked.

 

Each week you report on what you're seeing and set the direction: what should run, what should come off, and what we need to create. You work directly with our creative team, telling them what the account needs and why. Once the creative is produced, you build and launch the ads.

 

Requirements

- You have managed Meta ads for fashion or apparel brands, with real testing experience

- You know how to sell clothing without discounts, sales, countdowns or urgency. We don't run them

- Google Ads experience

- You can explain why one ad beat another. "It got a 4x" is not an explanation

- You can write a recommendation specific enough for us to produce from

- Steady judgment at lower order volumes, where a few unusual days are usually noise

- You work independently. We won't manage the account over your shoulder, and we need someone who runs it without being chased

- Available Mondays, and reliable with a weekly deadline

 

Preferred:

- Triple Whale. It's our source of truth for performance across channels, and we work from it rather than from what each platform reports about itself.

- You have shot, edited, or art-directed ads yourself. People who have made ads read performance differently.

 

Optional: Pinterest or TikTok advertising, and a working understanding of SEO.

 

AI

We use AI for analysis, reporting, and internal work. None of our visuals are AI-generated. Every image and video is shot by us, and we don't use AI to alter or extend our photography.

 

To apply

Apply through OnlineJobs. Start your message with "Without the discount," then answer the four questions below in the message itself.

 

Attach two files:

- Your resume, as a PDF

- Your portfolio, as a PDF: ad work for clothing or fashion brands, with what each ad achieved

 

Applications without both attachments won't be reviewed. Please don't send collections of links, or references to work unrelated to paid advertising for fashion. We review your message and the two files.

 

The four questions:

1. The fashion or apparel brands you've run ads for: the category, the price point, the monthly spend, and your role. If you can't name a brand, describe it.

2. Two ads from a clothing brand where one clearly beat the other. In a few sentences, tell us why: the hook, the format, what the first frame showed, and what the winner proved about the product that the other didn't.

3. One account you improved without a discount or a deadline: what you found, what you changed, how you knew it worked, and which numbers you trusted.

4. Your rate and weekly availability, including Mondays.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
WE’RE HIRING: Revenue Manager



Arbitrage Empire | Remote | Full-Time



Arbitrage Empire is looking for experienced Revenue Managers with extensive experience in short-term rental (STR) pricing, revenue optimization, and market analysis. We need data-driven professionals who can take ownership of pricing strategies across a large portfolio, maximize revenue, and make informed pricing decisions based on market trends and listing performance.



This is not an entry-level pricing role. We are looking for individuals who have managed pricing for 100+ short-term rental listings and can confidently make independent pricing decisions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Revenue Management & Pricing Strategy

•Develop, implement, and manage pricing strategies across a portfolio of 100+ short-term rental listings.

Take full ownership of daily pricing decisions, including base rates, minimum and maximum prices, seasonal adjustments, and discount strategies.

•Optimize rates based on demand, occupancy, booking pace, lead time, seasonality, local events, and competitor pricing.

•Balance occupancy and revenue while protecting owner profitability.

•Review and adjust pricing rules, minimum stays, last-minute discounts, weekly discounts, and other pricing customizations.

•Ensure minimum prices account for operating costs, platform fees, and applicable discounts to avoid unprofitable bookings.



2. Market & Listing Analysis

•Conduct regular market research and competitor analysis to identify pricing opportunities.

•Analyze listing performance, market positioning, and comparable properties.

•Identify underperforming listings, pricing gaps, low-demand periods, and opportunities to improve revenue.

•Investigate why listings are not receiving bookings and recommend data-driven solutions.

•Monitor market trends, local events, seasonality, and changes in demand.

•Provide recommendations on pricing adjustments based on actual performance data.



3. PriceLabs Management

•Manage and optimize pricing through PriceLabs.

•Review market dashboards, occupancy trends, booking windows, market percentiles, and comparable listing rates.

•Audit PriceLabs settings, rule sets, minimum prices, and customizations.

•Validate calculator assumptions against actual reservation payouts and operating expenses.

•Identify pricing configurations that may cause underpricing, excessive discounting, or missed revenue opportunities.



4. Performance Monitoring & Reporting

•Monitor daily pricing performance and booking pace across the assigned portfolio.

•Track key metrics, including occupancy, average daily rate (ADR), revenue per available night (RevPAN), booking conversion, and revenue performance against targets.

•Prepare regular pricing reports and highlight listings requiring immediate attention.

•Maintain clear documentation of pricing changes and the rationale behind major adjustments.

•Proactively communicate risks, opportunities, and recommended actions to management.



CEO Training & Onboarding

The selected Revenue Managers will shadow the CEO for one week to learn the company's pricing philosophy, portfolio requirements, operational standards, and revenue management expectations.



After the initial training week, the Revenue Manager is expected to independently manage their assigned portfolio, monitor market conditions, analyze listing performance, and take ownership of pricing decisions.



We are looking for someone who can move from guided training to independent execution quickly and confidently.



Qualifications & Requirements

•Extensive hands-on experience in short-term rental revenue management and dynamic pricing.

•Proven experience managing pricing for at least 100+ active listings.

•Advanced proficiency in PriceLabs, including customizations, rule sets, market dashboards, and pricing strategies.

•Strong understanding of STR market analysis, competitor benchmarking, demand forecasting, and seasonal pricing.

•Demonstrated ability to improve revenue performance through data-driven pricing decisions.

•Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret booking data, occupancy trends, ADR, and RevPAN.

•Experience diagnosing underperforming listings and developing actionable pricing plans.

•Ability to balance occupancy growth with profitability rather than relying solely on discounts.

•High attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to work independently.

•Strong written communication skills and the ability to explain pricing decisions clearly.



What We’re Looking For

We need revenue managers who do more than adjust nightly rates. You should understand why a property is or is not booking, how its pricing compares with the market, and what adjustments will improve performance without sacrificing profitability.



You should be comfortable managing a high-volume portfolio, making independent decisions, identifying pricing issues before they become client complaints, and continuously improving the company's revenue management process.



Application Requirements



Please include the following in your application:

1. A summary of your short-term rental revenue management experience.

2. The number of listings you have personally managed for pricing.

3. Your experience with PriceLabs and other revenue management tools.

4. Examples of how you improved occupancy, ADR, or overall revenue.

5. Your approach to analyzing listings that are not getting bookings.

6. Your expected monthly salary and availability.

7. Important: Applicants must have direct, hands-on experience managing pricing for 100+ listings. General property management experience without substantial revenue management responsibility will not be sufficient.

8. If you have the experience, analytical ability, and confidence to own pricing decisions across a large STR portfolio, we want to hear from you.



Apply here: 
/to/RPcQprBG



Apply now and join Arbitrage Empire’s revenue management team.

title: Creative Strategist – Direct-Response Video & Static Ads (Meta) for a Fast-Growing Sleep Brand
description:
About us

We are a direct-response e-commerce brand selling an ergonomic anti-snoring pillow across Scandinavia. Almost all of our growth comes from Meta ads: long advertorial-style videos, UGC videos, talking-head and VSL-style videos, song ads and static images. We have ads that have generated millions in revenue, and we launch new creatives every week.



Why this role is crucial

On Meta today, the creative is the targeting. Budget, audiences and settings matter far less than the ad itself. The brands that win are the ones that find new winning ads faster than their ads burn out.



That makes this the most important role in our marketing team. Our production team (editors, AI video and voice production, translators) can make almost anything. What they need is someone who tells them what to make and why. Every ad we launch starts with your concept, script and brief. If your ideas are strong, the whole company grows. If they are weak, everything after them is wasted. This is not a “write some hooks” job. You will own the creative direction of the brand.



What the role is about



Your job is to keep a constant pipeline of high-quality ad concepts that have a real chance of beating our current winners. You do that in three ways.



1. Ideation: new concepts from audience research

You need to understand our customer better than they understand themselves:



Our audience: mostly people 45+ who snore, their exhausted partners, and people with sleep apnea who have tried and given up on CPAP masks, mouth guards, nasal strips and mouth tape.

Where to research: reviews, ad comments, Reddit, forums, Amazon reviews of competing products and customer
s. You collect their exact words, frustrations, fears, objections and “aha” moments.

What you turn it into: new angles, hooks, avatars, stories and concepts. Examples: the partner’s point of view, the health scare, the failed-CPAP story, the “it’s not your fault” angle, the doctor or chiropractor angle.

The message every concept must carry: snoring doesn’t start in the nose. It starts in the neck. When you sleep on the wrong pillow, the neck bends, the jaw and tongue fall back, and the airway narrows. Our pillow holds head, neck and chin in the position where the airway stays open. Your job is to make that feel simple, relatable and believable, in 15 seconds or in 5 minutes.



2. Swipes: remaking proven winners from other brands

This is a big part of what we do today:



Find ads that are clearly winning for other brands (long-running, heavily scaled, many variations) in sleep, health, supplements, gadgets, wellness, or anything else with a great format.

Break each one down: hook, first 3 seconds, structure, pacing, proof, offer, CTA, and why it works psychologically.

Rewrite it for our product. Keep the proven structure and format, and swap in our problem, mechanism, offer (discount, 60-night risk-free trial, free shipping) and proof.

Deliver a full script plus a shot-by-shot brief. The brief marks which original visuals can be reused, which must be remade, and what new visuals are needed.



3. Iterations: getting the most out of our winners

When an ad works, we want 10 more like it:



Study our best-performing ads and the numbers behind them (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) to work out what exactly is working.

Write iterations: new hooks, new openings, new avatars and stories, new offers, shorter cuts for cold audiences, longer versions for warm ones.

Move winners into new formats, for example a winning video becomes statics, an advertorial becomes UGC, a talking head becomes a song ad, a story becomes a podcast clip.

Track what you tested and what you learned, so every round gets smarter.



What a normal week looks like



Research audience and competitors, and update the swipe file with breakdowns

Write 10 new scripts or concepts, each with a brief and a short “why this should win” note

Review last week’s ad results with us and plan iterations of the winners

Answer questions from editors and production so your ideas are executed the way you intended



Who we’re looking for



At least 1–2 years as a creative strategist, direct-response copywriter or performance creative for e-commerce or DTC brands on Meta

Strong knowledge of direct-response fundamentals: hooks, angles, awareness levels, mechanism-based copy (unique problem and unique solution), offers and objection handling

Able to read ad data and connect it to creative decisions

Experience swiping and adapting winning ads, and writing scripts for long and short formats

Excellent written English. We publish in Swedish, Norwegian and Danish, and translation is handled separately.

Self-driven: you bring ideas without being asked

Plus: experience in health or wellness products, older audiences, advertorials and VSLs, or briefing AI video and image tools and UGC creators



Details



Long-term. The right person will grow into leading our creative team.



How we hire (please read carefully)



We only hire people who can prove they are good. The process has three stages.



Stage 1 – Application (required to be reviewed)



Start your application with the word “AIRWAY”.

Send 2–3 ads you personally concepted or scripted, as links or files. For each one, tell us:

What your role was (idea, script, brief, research?)

What format it was and who it targeted

How it performed (spend, ROAS, CPA, or at least whether it became a winner)

Answer briefly:

What is the difference between an angle, a hook and a concept?

How do you d
 whether an ad failed because of the hook, the body or the offer?

What is the best ad you’ve seen in the last month, and why does it work?



Applications without these answers will not be reviewed.



Stage 2 – Test task (for shortlisted applicants)

You will get a short brief about our product, audience and mechanism. Then:



Swipe: find one winning ad from another brand that we should remake. Break it down, then write the full script for our product with a shot-by-shot brief.

Ideation: pitch 3 original concepts based on your own research. For each, give the angle, the hook (first 3 seconds), a short outline, and the audience insight it comes from.

Iteration: we send you one of our winning ads. Write 5 new hooks and 1 version in a completely different format.



Stage 3 – Paid trial week

The best 1–2 candidates do a paid trial week working on real briefs with our team. We produce and test your ads. The results, and how you think and communicate, d
 who gets the job.

When you reply to this job posting, please include Job Posting 0312 at the end of the subject line.

Also, when you respond, please list out in the body of the
 your specific experience working in a medical office along with references who we can call.



Only applicants who follow all the instructions listed in this posting will be considered. If you are unable to complete all of the requested items, please do not apply to this position as you will not be considered.



Thank you!



Video Script:



Mental illness in the United States continues to rise. In 2019 the National Institute of Mental Health reported that one in five adults lives with mental illness. As the result of the COVID-19 pandemic, people are under increased amounts of pressure and, in most cases, are isolated from their pre-pandemic support network. In a recent article, The Atlantic declared, "The mental-health crisis of the pandemic is real." Individuals at all levels are being affected, including families. Since the pandemic began, twenty-four percent of parents have reported being diagnosed with a mental health disorder.

Despite how widespread mental illness is in America, misconceptions about mental illness continue to exist. Individuals with mental health conditions often feel stigmatized by others once they reveal their illness. When this happens, some people find a lack of understanding by family, coworkers, and employers.



The Silent Illness



Mental illnesses include several different conditions such as depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder, and more. By applying biological psychology, which studies the relationship between psychological processes and the underlying physiological events, new and more effective therapies are becoming available for mental health patients. Diagnosing and treating, however, is dependent on individuals being willing to seek treatment.

Many people fear that seeking help will confirm that there is something wrong with them. This is because of the cultural stigma generated by the media, individuals, and society in general.

Due to the intense stigma attached to mental illness, it is a topic that is hidden and silenced. The silence surrounding it is what allows the stigma of mental illness to continue.

description:
ABOUT US

Ode Bible is a Christian music app. Every chapter of the Bible is set to music in many styles. We run a group of music brands that share these songs on social media, and we need careful people to set up the official accounts for ONE brand each.



THE TASK (ABOUT 8 DAYS, ABOUT 3 HOURS IN TOTAL, ON YOUR OWN TIME)

You get a private task page with the brand name, company
, photo and bio. On your phone you:

1. Create the brand's YouTube channel,
 Page, Instagram, TikTok and Snapchat. Bluesky, Threads and Pinterest are a bonus if they work for you.

2. Use the brand's Instagram and TikTok for the first week: we send you 7 short videos and you post one a day. No following, liking or commenting.

3. Connect the accounts to our posting tool from your task page, and transfer the YouTube channel and
 Page to us. We give you the steps.



PAY

$10 for the brand, paid by Wise (GCash or bank) in your own name when the brand is finished. If you cannot finish for some reason, we work it out with you and pay you fairly for the work you did. If an app blocks you through no fault of yours, send a screenshot and move on. Bluesky, Threads and Pinterest never affect your pay. There is no unpaid trial.



RULES

- One brand per person. Use only the company
 on your task page.

- Use your own phone and normal internet. No VPN.

- If an app shows a warning or a check you cannot finish, stop and send us a screenshot. Never make a second account to get around it.

- The accounts belong to Ode Bible.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Based in the Philippines, with a smartphone

- Careful with instructions, and able to spend about 10 minutes a day for a week

- Comfortable with Christian content

- GCash or a bank account in your own name



HOW TO APPLY

 

Subject line: ODE GIG - [your full name]

Replace the words in square brackets with your own name.

Tell us: 1) your phone model, 2) whether any TikTok, Instagram or Snapchat account of yours was ever restricted or banned, 3) which day you can start.
salary: $10 per brand, paid at end via Wise

title: Chief of Staff (COO and Executive Director)
description:
About PHNYX Group

PHNYX Group is a venture studio with operations in Dubai, Switzerland and China. We partner with founders to build, scale and exit ecommerce brands.

Our founder has built multiple brands, including PHNYX Watches, which has done millions in revenue. We are building a team that can run without him in every room.



Why this role exists

Our founder has the vision. We need the person who turns it into a team that delivers every day. You will act for him, make decisions for him, run the team, and bring him a clear picture of the business every day.

This is not an assistant job. You will lead.



What you will own

- Every team and every process across PHNYX and our partner brands

- Turning our founder's ideas into plans, owners and dates

- Taking reports from every team member and holding them to their numbers

- A daily summary for our founder, and the weekly team call

- Hiring full-time staff and freelancers, and letting go of people who don't deliver

- Payroll, the money plan and our cash reserves

- Client happiness: response times, results, onboarding and upsells

- GoHighLevel: landing pages, pipelines and automations

- Overseeing our Shopify stores and the teams behind them

- Representing our founder and our brand to clients, partners and the world



What success looks like

After 90 days:

- Every role is hired, clear on its numbers and reporting to you

- Our founder never has to chase anyone for an update

- Clients are happier and staying longer

- Leads, calls and cash are going up every month



Who we are looking for

Someone who truly believes in what we are building and wants to be part of it, not just paid by it. You stay calm and lead when a month is hard. You are not scared to tell a team member they are not delivering.

You have worked inside an ecommerce brand (not only an agency) and know Shopify well: orders, products, apps and reports. You use AI and GoHighLevel every day, you write clearly, and you make decisions without waiting to be told.



How we hire

Everyone who joins PHNYX is scored on four things: Capability, Capacity, Skill and Character. You need to pass all four.



Compensation

- $2,000/month to start, paid via PayPal or card payment (not bank transfer)

- $2,500/month when we enroll 40+ clients a month, 3 months in a row

- $3,500/month as the team grows to 12-15+ and we hit consistent six-figure months

- $20,000 annual bonus when all yearly targets are met

- Remote, Philippines preferred, with the opportunity to move to Dubai



How to apply

- Subject line: "Chief of Staff - [Your Name]" (we use this to check attention to detail)

- The ecommerce brands or founders you ran operations for, your title and the team size

- Proof of results: growth you helped drive, systems you built, screenshots of your GHL and Shopify work

- A Loom video, 5 minutes max: introduce yourself and tell us why you want to build this with us

- Your answers to the application questions



Application questions

Each question asks for specifics that are hard to fake. Vague answers score low.

1. Which ecommerce brand or founder did you run operations for? How big was the team, and what did YOU own?

2. Show us one GHL automation or landing page you built. What did it do?

3. Tell us about a time you had to let someone go. What happened, and how did you handle it?

4. It is a month with no cash collected and our reserves are almost gone. What do you do in the first 7 days?

5. Why PHNYX? What about what we are building would keep you here in a hard month?

6. How do you use Claude or ChatGPT in your work? Give one real example.

7. A team member keeps missing deadlines but is liked by everyone. What do you do?

8. How would you measure whether our clients are truly happy?

9. Our founder is away for 2 weeks. How do you run the team so nothing slips?

10. Can you cover Dubai working hours, 5 days a week, with some US Eastern overlap? Yes or no.

11. Walk us through a Shopify store you helped run. What did you manage day to day, and what did you fix or improve?

title: IT Administrator
description:
The IT Manager is responsible for ensuring our technology infrastructure, tools, and processes support a growing team efficiently and securely. This is a founding IT role - the company has some processes in place but much of the IT function is underdeveloped, and this person will be expected to both operate hands-on from day one and build the systems and standards that scale with us.



A core initial focus is identity and access management: managing the full user lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding, and ensuring access to tools is accurate, timely, and auditable. Alongside this, the role is responsible for identifying gaps in our IT processes and building the policies, documentation, and workflows to close them.



This role reports to the CTO and works closely with HR, Operations, and team leads across the business. The right person is equally comfortable executing day-to-day access tasks and stepping back to design the process around them. They have strong Google Workspace Admin experience, a solid understanding of IAM concepts, and the judgment to prioritise what to build first in an environment where not everything exists yet.



Core Responsibilities

- Review and approve access requests for all new hires. For tools with direct integrations, approval triggers automatic provisioning. For tools without, manually complete the setup inside the tool itself.

- Offboard departing employees same business day — approve removal and manually revoke access in any tools that require it.

- Process access change requests — update a user's permission when their role, responsibilities, or required access level changes.

- Work with managers to create and maintain access templates when new role types are added.

- Run periodic access reviews to confirm the access inventory is accurate and up to date.

- Identify gaps in existing IT processes and build the policies, documentation, and workflows to address them.

- Own IT policy development — covering areas such as device management, acceptable use, data handling, and security standards.

- Be the first point of contact for access requests, access questions, and IT support across the business.

- Keep process documentation current so every access change and IT procedure is repeatable and auditable.

title: Video Editor (CapCut Specialist) and Virtual Assistant, Part-Time, As-Needed, with Room to Grow

Edit short-form videos (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and hype or highlight videos for events, racing and truck programs. These need fast pacing, beat-synced cuts, captions, transitions and music.

Edit longer videos for businesses, including construction project showcases, promos and testimonials.

Edit and organize photography and videography, including color grading, culling and exports. This includes real estate photo and video editing.

Assist with light admin work for our construction client: organizing project photos and footage, and posting to social media.

Deliver on time, communicate clearly, and keep projects organized in shared folders.



Where this role can go

We run a full digital marketing firm, and workload grows as we sign clients. If you have skills in any of the following, tell us. They can lead to more hours, more responsibility and higher pay:



Website building (GoHighLevel, WordPress, Shopify, or custom HTML/CSS)

GoHighLevel (GHL) workflows, funnels, CRM setup and automations

Real estate marketing, including listing photos, video tours and social content for agents

Social media management and scheduling

Google Business Profile and basic SEO



Required



Advanced CapCut skills. We work in CapCut and share projects, so you must be able to edit in it and collaborate in the same projects. Please tell us whether you use CapCut desktop, mobile or both, and whether you’ve used its team or cloud features.

A portfolio or reel of work you personally edited, with links.

Strong sense of pacing, audio and text. Our content is energetic, not corporate.

Good, stable internet and a computer that can handle 4K footage.

Clear written English.

Fast responses. You must reply to new assignments within a few hours during US business hours, even when you aren’t working that day.

Reliable delivery. Missing deadlines or going silent is the one thing we can’t work with.



Nice to have



Photo editing in Lightroom or Photoshop

Drone footage, color grading, sound design

Any of the skills listed under “Where this role can go”

Experience with automotive, motorsports, construction, real estate or small-business content



Schedule and workload



Part-time, as-needed. Expect roughly [10–20] hours a week on average, but it will vary. Some weeks will be busier and some lighter.

Projects come with a clear deadline and brief. You schedule the work around it.

Some availability during US Eastern business hours (9am–1pm ET) for quick questions and feedback

A short weekly check-in

This is a long-term working relationship, not a one-off gig. The right person will be our first call for every project.



Pay



Starting rate: $5/hour, for hours worked, paid every Friday through [Wise/PayPal]

Paid test edit before hiring

Performance review after 60 days. Raises are based on reliability, quality and any added skills you take on (website, GHL, real estate).

[Optional: $25–50 bonus for any month where every deadline is met]



How to apply

Start your message with the word “CAPCUT” so I know you read this. Then include:



Links to 2–3 videos you edited in CapCut

Your general availability and time zone

Which CapCut version you use and your computer’s RAM

Which of the extra skills above you have (website building, GoHighLevel, real estate, photo editing), with examples if you can

One thing you’d change in your favorite video to make it hit harder



Shortlisted applicants will get a paid test edit (about 1 hour of footage cut down to a 30–45 second reel).



Questions:

1. Which CapCut version do you use, and what’s your computer’s RAM?

2. Have you edited together with a client in a shared CapCut project? How?

3. Do you have experience with GoHighLevel, website building or real estate content? Describe it briefly.

4. This is part-time and as-needed. Are you comfortable with variable hours, and can you reply within a few hours of a new assignment?

title: Account Manager
description:
Position Summary



The Account Manager is the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of clients. This role protects and grows recurring revenue by understanding each client’s business objectives, ensuring dependable service delivery, resolving issues with urgency, and identifying practical opportunities to expand Barrister’s value. The Account Manager serves as a trusted advisor and internal quarterback, aligning sales, operations, service delivery, finance, and subject-matter experts around measurable client outcomes.



Essential Responsibilities



Client Relationship Ownership & Retention

-Own day-to-day and strategic relationships for assigned accounts, serving as a responsive, dependable point of contact for client stakeholders.

-Build and maintain multi-level relationships with executive sponsors, decision makers, procurement, IT/operations leaders, and end users; create and maintain current relationship maps.

-Develop a thorough understanding of each client’s business model, priorities, operating environment, contractual commitments, and definition of success.

-Conduct regular account touchpoints and formal Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to review performance, risks, business priorities, realized value, and upcoming opportunities.

-Measure and improve client health, satisfaction, retention, and advocacy; actively gather feedback and turn it into clear actions and follow-up communication.

-Anticipate concerns, identify churn or service risks early, and lead timely recovery plans through resolution and client confirmation.



Account Strategy, Revenue Growth & Commercial Management

-Create, maintain, and execute an account business plan for each assigned client, including revenue and margin goals, renewal milestones, growth targets, relationship strategy, risk mitigation, and action owners.

-Identify whitespace and customer needs that can be addressed through appropriate services, solutions, upgrades, renewals, cross-sell, or upsell opportunities.

-Lead consultative discovery and value-based conversations; translate client requirements into practical recommendations, proposals, and measurable business cases.

-Partner with Sales Executives and technical or operational teams to qualify opportunities, develop solutions, prepare pricing and proposals, negotiate within authority, and close business.

-Protect profitability by considering scope, delivery feasibility, service levels, costs, pricing, and contract commitments before making or presenting commitments.

-Drive contract renewal planning well in advance of expiration, including commercial strategy, client alignment, required approvals, and complete CRM documentation.



Service Delivery, Escalation & Internal Leadership

-Coordinate cross-functional resources to ensure products and services are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in accordance with service-level agreements (SLAs).

-Act as the client advocate internally while balancing client needs with company commitments, operational realities, compliance obligations, and financial goals.

-Lead escalations from initial triage through documented corrective action, regular status communication, root-cause review when appropriate, and confirmed closure.

-Monitor service performance, deliverables, invoicing, scheduling, and key dependencies; promptly escalate material delivery, cost, quality, or compliance risks.

-Participate in client kickoffs, implementation transitions, and service reviews to establish clear expectations, ownership, communication cadence, and success measures.

-Develop and communicate account-level project plans for material client initiatives, clearly defining milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and completion criteria.

-Standardize and refine delivery processes across the portfolio so strategic clients receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

-Support continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues, process gaps, training needs, and scalable improvements across accounts.



Financial, Data & Pipeline Discipline

-Manage to assigned revenue, retention, margin, renewal, expansion, and customer-experience targets.

-Maintain accurate, timely CRM records for contacts, opportunities, account plans, activities, renewal dates, forecasts, risks, and next steps.

-Review account health and financial performance, including volume trends, utilization, margin, expenses, invoicing, and SLA compliance; flag variances and potential overruns immediately.

-Provide clear weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting and forecasts, including pipeline, renewal outlook, wins, risks, recovery actions, and required leadership support.

-Use client data, industry insight, and internal performance information to prioritize initiatives, substantiate recommendations, and quantify value or return on investment.



Client Enablement & Business Improvement

-Provide or coordinate client-specific education, enablement, and supporting materials that improve adoption, service outcomes, and growth of the company’s offerings.

-Identify and implement service-delivery and account-management improvements that reduce avoidable cost, improve efficiency, and protect the client experience.

-Use formal customer evaluations and feedback channels to validate satisfaction, recognize performance gaps, and drive continuous improvement.

-Maintain appropriate confidentiality and discretion when handling client, commercial, operational, or financial information.



Qualifications



Required

-Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

-3+ years of client-facing account management, customer success, sales, service management, project management, or related experience; experience managing complex B2B accounts preferred.

-Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships, retain business, solve problems, and manage several priorities with sound judgment.

-Strong written, verbal, presentation, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills.

-Ability to work effectively across a matrixed organization and influence internal and external stakeholders at multiple levels.

-Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint.



Preferred

-Experience meeting revenue, renewal, growth, margin, or customer-satisfaction goals within a technology, managed services, IT lifecycle, telecommunications, logistics, or other complex service environment.

-Experience delivering QBRs, account business plans, complex proposals, renewals, and contract negotiations.

-Experience coordinating service delivery, technical, logistics, finance, or operational teams for complex client programs.

-Working knowledge of the company’s relevant solutions, delivery model, competitive landscape, and client industry.



Core Competencies



-Client-centered and consultative: listens carefully, earns credibility, connects solutions to business outcomes, and communicates honestly.

-Commercially accountable: balances client value with revenue, margin, scope, and long-term account health.

-Proactive and organized: anticipates needs, follows through, manages deadlines, and maintains complete documentation.

-Analytical and solutions-oriented: uses data to recognize patterns, diagnose issues, prioritize actions, and improve results.

-Collaborative and resilient: coordinates diverse teams, handles difficult conversations professionally, and remains calm under pressure.

-Ethical and dependable: protects confidential information, honors commitments, follows policies, and exercises sound judgment.



Performance Measures



-Specific targets will be established by leadership based on portfolio type, account maturity, and company priorities. Typical measures include:

-Revenue retention, renewal rate, expansion revenue, quota attainment, and year-over-year growth.

-Portfolio margin, pricing discipline, forecast accuracy, invoice timeliness, and control of avoidable costs or overruns.

-Client satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS) or equivalent feedback, churn, issue-response time, and escalation resolution.

-SLA performance, implementation/service quality, account-plan completion, QBR completion, CRM data quality, and pipeline coverage.

-Quality of executive relationships, client engagement, teamwork, and demonstrated contribution to scalable process improvements.



Work Environment & Additional Information



This position may require occasional travel to client locations, industry events, or internal meetings, depending on portfolio needs. The duties and responsibilities above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and are not an exhaustive list. Management may assign additional duties consistent with the role and business needs.



Equipment and System Requirements



This is a remote role. You must provide your own computer and setup that meet these minimum specifications before onboarding:



-Operating system: Windows 11 Pro only, genuine and fully updated

-Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (or equivalent)

-Memory (RAM): at least 16GB

-Storage: at least 256GB SSD (solid-state drive)

-Internet: dedicated connection with at least 100 Mbps download, 20 Mbps upload, and under 80 ms ping

-Peripherals: noise-canceling USB headset and HD webcam

-Backup power: uninterruptible power supply (UPS) or another backup power solution



Not accepted: Apple/Mac computers, Chromebooks, Linux, any operating system other than Windows 11 Pro, and hard disk drives (HDD).



During screening, you’ll be asked to submit a screenshot of your computer’s specifications and a speed test result. Candidates whose equipment doesn’t meet these requirements can’t be onboarded.

title: Experienced Real Estate Assistant
description:
This Is Not a Basic Data-Entry Position



Just the Best Property Group is looking for a highly reliable, resourceful, and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who can help keep our leads, clients, agents, transactions, and business systems moving forward. We are a growing company, and this role is intended to grow with the right person. A team member who consistently demonstrates reliability, initiative, sound judgment, and strong results can earn greater responsibility, increased compensation, performance bonuses, and the opportunity to develop into a higher-level operations or leadership role as the company expands.



We are not looking for someone who waits to be reminded, disappears when a task becomes difficult, or marks work complete without confirming the result. We need someone who communicates early, follows through consistently, and takes ownership from assignment through completion. The right person has a determined-to-learn attitude. You may not know every answer on day one, but you know how to research using Google, YouTube, help centers, training resources, and other available tools. You ask thoughtful questions after first making a reasonable effort to solve the problem. You can think quickly and adapt when plans change, while still valuing structured systems, checklists, and consistency. You are optimistic, coachable, and comfortable with accountability because you see it as a tool for growth and excellent performance. You communicate clearly about your progress, questions, needs, deadlines, and mistakes.



At your core, you lead by serving. You are willing to encourage and support others, and you understand that greater opportunities are earned through contribution, reliability, sound judgment, and results.



What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

• Complete commitments accurately and on time without repeated reminders.

• Keep Alex and the team informed before a deadline is at risk—not afterward.

• Maintain accurate CRM records so every lead has a clear status, notes, and next action.

• Follow up consistently so qualified opportunities do not fall through the cracks.

• Learn unfamiliar tools and processes independently, then document what you learned.

• Catch missing information, inconsistencies, and unfinished work before they become problems.

• Bring possible solutions when raising an issue.

• Protect confidential client, financial, and transaction information.



Core Responsibilities

1. CRM and Database Management

• Maintain a large and frequently changing client and prospect database in Brivity or a future CRM.

• Keep records, stages, tags, notes, tasks, and next-follow-up dates accurate and current.

• Identify duplicate, incomplete, stale, or incorrectly categorized records.

• Import, export, clean, organize, and validate CSV and Excel files without losing or corrupting data.



2. Lead Follow-Up and Communication

• Contact prospective and current clients by phone, text, and
.

• Use approved scripts, thoughtful questions, active listening, and motivational interviewing principles to qualify leads and move them through the pipeline.

• Maintain proactive short- and long-term follow-up so no viable lead is forgotten.

• Communicate warmly and professionally both on and off the phone.

• Accurately document every meaningful interaction and next step in the CRM.



3. Team Leader and Executive Support

• Learn Alex’s schedule, priorities, communication preferences, and work style.

• Take clear, concise meeting notes and convert decisions into assigned action items with deadlines.

• Manage, delegate, or minimize distractions that interfere with the team’s highest-value priorities.

• Monitor commitments and follow up with the appropriate person until each item is resolved.

• Prepare Alex for meetings and regularly scheduled Zoom calls.



4. Systems and Process Implementation

• Help build, implement, and improve processes for buyers, sellers, lead generation, database management, transaction support, and team operations.

• Use checklists, templates, automations, and quality-control steps to make work more consistent.

• Notice breakdowns and recommend practical improvements.



5. Operations Manual Management

• Create and maintain a clear, usable operations manual.

• Document workflows, responsibilities, scripts, templates, standards, and step-by-step procedures.

• Update documentation when a process changes rather than allowing instructions to become outdated.



6. Tracking and Reporting

• Track and report key activities and results, including calls, conversations, appointments, leads generated, contracts, closings, and follow-up completion.

• Build and maintain organized Google Sheets and Excel trackers.

• Use formulas, filters, lookups, conditional formatting, multiple-sheet references, and basic data analysis—not only data entry.

• Review reports for missing or inconsistent data and explain what the numbers indicate.



7. Agent and Client Support

• Assist multiple agents with contact management, client inquiries, appointment scheduling, reminders, and follow-up systems.

• Keep requests organized by priority and deadline.

• Provide professional, service-oriented communication while maintaining appropriate boundaries and confidentiality.



8. Marketing Support

• Assist with newsletters, follow-up campaigns, items of value, MOFIRs, and other
 marketing through platforms such as Flodesk or Mailchimp.

• Coordinate and, when needed, create social media posts and simple videos using Canva and CapCut.

• Proofread content, check links and details, schedule approved materials, and confirm successful publication or delivery.



9. Transaction Coordination Support

• Help track pending transactions from contract through closing.

• Monitor dates, documents, signatures, contingencies, and outstanding action items.

• Communicate professionally with agents, clients, lenders, attorneys, inspectors, vendors, and other parties as directed.

• Handle confidential documents and information carefully.



10. Client Event Coordination

• Assist with planning and executing client events.

• Research and communicate with venues and vendors, manage invitation lists and RSVPs, organize timelines, and track details through completion.



Non-Negotiable Qualifications

• A demonstrated record of excellent reliability, attendance, and follow-through in remote work.

• Strong spoken and written English suitable for professional client communication.

• Confidence making and receiving phone calls with U.S.-based prospects and clients.

• Strong attention to detail and the habit of checking work before submission.

• Ability to prioritize multiple assignments, maintain task lists, and meet deadlines without constant supervision.

• Intermediate or advanced Google Sheets and Excel skills, including formulas and working across multiple sheets.

• A dependable computer, stable high-speed internet, professional headset, quiet work environment, and a realistic backup plan for power or internet interruptions.

• Experience managing a CRM or another complex database.

• Strong research and problem-solving ability.

• Ability to learn software quickly and document repeatable processes.

• Consistent availability during the agreed schedule and for regular Zoom meetings.



Strongly Preferred

• Experience supporting a U.S. real estate agent, team, brokerage, or transaction coordinator.

• Experience with Brivity or a comparable real estate CRM.

• Experience with lead follow-up, inside sales, appointment setting, or client care.

• Experience with Google Workspace, Microsoft Excel, Canva, CapCut, Flodesk, Mailchimp, and task-management tools.

• Experience creating SOPs, maintaining operations manuals, or producing KPI reports.

• Familiarity with U.S. real estate transactions, terminology, and deadlines.



This Role Is Probably Not a Fit If You

• Frequently miss shifts, meetings, or deadlines.

• Need repeated reminders to complete routine responsibilities.

• Avoid phone calls or are uncomfortable initiating follow-up.

• Stop when instructions are incomplete instead of researching, thinking, and asking a focused question.

• Hide mistakes, delays, or uncertainty.

• Submit work without checking its accuracy or confirming that the intended result occurred.

• Are balancing another full-time job during the hours committed to this role.



How to Apply

Please follow every instruction below. Applications that omit a required item will not move forward.

1. Begin your application with the exact phrase: BEST — [Your Full Name].

2. Write 5–8 sentences explaining why this specific position fits your experience and working style.  Do not send a generic cover letter.  

3. State the U.S. Eastern Time hours you can work and describe your power and internet backup plans for when it may go out.

4. Include a link to a 60–90 second video introduction. 

Answer these questions:

• Describe what you're looking for in a role? Are you looking for full time, part time, long term etc.

• Rate your Excel/Google Sheets ability from 1–10 and your favorite features.

• Describe your experience with CRMs, lead follow-up whether through phones or other means, real estate transactions, SOPs, and reporting. Be specific about your responsibilities.



7. Include one redacted work sample that demonstrates organization or technical skill, such as a spreadsheet, KPI report, SOP, CRM workflow, project tracker, or marketing calendar. Remove all confidential information.



8. Provide the names, positions, and contact information of two recent professional references who directly supervised your work. References will be contacted only for finalists. Finalists should expect at least 2 rounds of live interviews. Employment will begin with a structured introductory period with clear expectations for attendance, communication, accuracy, learning, and completed results.



We are looking for a long-term team member who wants to grow through meaningful responsibility. This is an opportunity to join a growing company where successful performance can lead to expanded leadership roles, income and professional development, and advancement. Salary is starting salary, increases and Bonuses are incorporated and performance based. If you are dependable, thoughtful, highly organized, comfortable with accountability, and determined to find solutions, we would like to hear from you.

title: Amazon Sourcing Specialist  Experienced Applicants Only
description:
## HIRING: Experienced Amazon FBA Product Sourcing VA



**Next Level FBA** is hiring a reliable virtual assistant to find profitable products for our Amazon US business.



The primary focus is **online arbitrage sourcing**. Experience analyzing wholesale catalogs is a plus. We’re looking for someone who can research independently, explain their buying recommendations, and consistently submit accurate, actionable leads.



### Position details



- **Location:** Remote

- **Hours:** Up to 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday

- **Pay:** $2–$4 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability

- **Opportunity:** Ongoing work based on performance



### What you’ll do



- Source products from reputable US retailers and approved suppliers.

- Use **Keepa and SellerAmp** to evaluate pricing history, demand, competition, Amazon’s presence, and profitability.

- Verify exact product matches, including model, size, color, quantity, and pack count.

- Calculate estimated profit and ROI using applicable Amazon fees, shipping, prep costs, and taxes.

- Flag potential IP complaints, restrictions, hazmat issues, and other purchasing risks for review.

- Maintain an organized sourcing sheet with complete information and clear notes.

- Provide daily updates and apply feedback to improve future submissions.



### Our general sourcing targets



- **40%+ ROI**

- **$3+ estimated net profit per unit**

- **Preferred selling price of $29.99 or higher**

- **50+ estimated monthly sales on the listing**, with competition considered

- Consistent pricing and demand supported by Keepa history

- Reliable sources with clear product information



A product must make sense beyond the numbers shown in a sourcing tool. You should be able to explain the opportunity, identify the risks, and recognize when a temporary price increase makes a lead look better than it is.



### What we’re looking for



- Hands-on experience sourcing for Amazon US

- Strong working knowledge of Keepa and SellerAmp

- Independent research skills and attention to detail

- Clear written English and reliable communication

- Ability to follow sourcing criteria and improve based on feedback



Performance will be evaluated on **lead accuracy, approval rate, consistency, and communication**.



### How to apply



Send a message beginning with **“AMAZON SOURCING”** and include:



1. Your relevant experience and most recent sourcing responsibilities.

2. The tools and sourcing methods you use.

3. Your availability, time zone, and expected hourly rate in USD.

4. **Three sample products you have personally researched.**



For each sample, include:



- Source link and Amazon link/ASIN

- Purchase cost and expected selling price

- Estimated net profit and ROI

- Estimated monthly listing sales

- A Keepa screenshot

- A brief explanation of why you would recommend buying it and any risks you identified



Please include all requested information so we can properly evaluate your application.



We’re looking for someone who takes ownership of their work and can become a dependable part of the business.

title: SEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist | Website Development | Remote (Night Shift)
description:
# SEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist | Website Development | Remote (Night Shift)



**Job Type:** Remote  

**Schedule:** Graveyard Shift (Night Shift Required)  

**Communication:** Fluent Written and Spoken English Required  

**Reporting:** Weekly Performance Reports and Team Meetings



## Job Overview



We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented, and results-driven **SEO & AI Search Optimization Specialist** with experience in website development, search engine optimization, and AI-powered search visibility.



The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of traditional SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), including strategies to improve website visibility across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI-powered search platforms.



We are looking for someone who is proactive, analytical, technically proficient, and capable of working independently while maintaining consistent communication with our team.



**This position requires availability during graveyard shift hours, participation in scheduled Google Meet meetings, and submission of detailed weekly performance reports.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

- Develop and execute comprehensive SEO strategies to improve organic search rankings and website traffic.

- Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and SEO audits.

- Optimize website content, metadata, headings, internal links, and site structure.

- Implement technical SEO improvements, including site speed, mobile responsiveness, indexing, and crawlability.

- Monitor website performance using Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and other SEO tools.

- Identify opportunities to increase organic traffic, lead generation, and conversions.



### 2. AI Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO)

- Develop strategies to improve brand visibility across AI-powered search engines and answer platforms.

- Optimize website content for AI-generated answers, summaries, and recommendations.

- Implement structured data and schema markup where appropriate.

- Research emerging AI search trends and recommend improvements.

- Monitor and report on brand visibility and citations within AI-generated search results.

- Stay current with developments in AI search technology and optimization practices.



### 3. Website Development & Maintenance

- Build, update, maintain, and optimize websites.

- Ensure websites are responsive, user-friendly, professional, and optimized for performance.

- Troubleshoot website errors, broken links, technical issues, and functionality problems.

- Implement SEO recommendations directly into website design and structure.

- Manage website updates, plugins, integrations, and security best practices.

- Collaborate with the team on website improvements, landing pages, and new development projects.



### 4. Weekly Reporting & Performance Tracking



**Detailed weekly reports are mandatory.**



Each weekly report must include:



- Summary of tasks completed during the week.

- SEO ranking changes and keyword performance.

- Website traffic, engagement, and conversion metrics.

- AI search visibility improvements and observations.

- Website development updates and technical issues resolved.

- Progress toward established goals and KPIs.

- Outstanding tasks, challenges, and recommended solutions.

- Action plan and priorities for the upcoming week.



Reports must be accurate, organized, supported by measurable data when available, and submitted by the established weekly deadline.



### 5. Team Communication & Collaboration

- Attend scheduled team meetings via Google Meet.

- Provide clear verbal updates on current projects, performance, and progress.

- Communicate proactively regarding deadlines, challenges, and project requirements.

- Collaborate effectively with management and other team members.

- Maintain consistent availability and responsiveness throughout scheduled working hours.



## Required Qualifications



- Proven experience in SEO, website optimization, and website development.

- Strong understanding of AEO and GEO strategies.

- Experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and industry-standard SEO tools.

- Proficiency with website platforms such as WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, or similar systems.

- Understanding of HTML, CSS, technical SEO, and structured data.

- Ability to analyze performance metrics and develop actionable recommendations.

- **Excellent spoken and written English proficiency is mandatory.**

- Comfortable participating in live Google Meet meetings and presenting weekly updates.

- Ability to work consistently during assigned graveyard shift hours.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and time management.

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and take initiative without constant supervision.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Demonstrated success improving organic search rankings and website traffic.

- Experience optimizing websites for AI-powered search platforms.

- Familiarity with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, or similar platforms.

- Experience with conversion rate optimization and lead generation.

- Portfolio of websites developed or optimized.

- Ability to provide case studies or measurable examples of previous SEO results.



## Performance Expectations



The selected candidate will be expected to:



- Consistently complete assigned tasks and meet project deadlines.

- Demonstrate measurable progress toward established SEO and website performance goals.

- Submit comprehensive weekly reports without reminders.

- Participate actively in scheduled Google Meet meetings.

- Communicate professionally and clearly in English.

- Identify problems, propose solutions, and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

- Maintain a high level of productivity, accountability, and professionalism.



## How to Apply



Interested applicants should submit:



1. An updated resume highlighting relevant experience.

2. A portfolio of websites developed, managed, or optimized.

3. Examples of successful SEO projects, including measurable results.

4. A brief explanation of their experience with AI Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO).

5. A list of SEO, analytics, and website development tools they are proficient in.

6. Confirmation of availability to work graveyard shifts and attend scheduled Google Meet meetings.



**We are looking for a long-term team member who is dependable, results-oriented, technologically knowledgeable, and committed to helping our business grow through strong online visibility and website performance.**
