**Remote Position | Philippine Night Shift**



**Asset Recovery Agents of America LLC** is hiring experienced cold callers to connect with potential clients in the United States.



**About Our Business**



We help former property owners and their heirs recover surplus funds they may be entitled to receive. Surplus funds are money that may remain after a foreclosure or tax auction once applicable debts, taxes, fees, and expenses have been paid.



Our company researches potential claims, locates the correct owners or heirs, and assists with the recovery process. Clients pay no upfront fees; our company earns a fee when funds are successfully recovered.



**What You Will Do**



- Make outbound calls using company-provided leads.

- Determine whether you have reached the correct former property owner or an appropriate heir.

- Introduce our company and explain our surplus funds recovery services.

- Gather basic information and identify interested potential clients.

- Maintain accurate call notes and follow-up records.

- Pass positive leads and case details to the owner/manager.



The owner/manager will conduct further research to determine whether money may be owed to the potential client, explain the next steps, and send contracts when appropriate. Cold callers must not promise that funds are available or guarantee a recovery.



**Schedule and Pay**



- **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. U.S. Mountain Standard Time (MST, UTC−7).

- **Hours:** 40 hours per week.

- **Pay:** $2.50 USD per hour — $100 USD for 40 hours worked.

- **Payday:** Every Friday, U.S. time.

- **Training:** Begins immediately.

- **Full-time cold calling starts:** November 2, 2026.



**Applicants must convert the listed U.S. days and hours to the current Philippine schedule and confirm that they can consistently work those hours.**



**Required Qualifications**



- Your own computer, reliable internet connection, and headset.

- A quiet workspace suitable for professional calls.

- Clear spoken English and strong listening skills.

- Previous cold calling experience.

- Some understanding of the surplus funds recovery business.

- Professionalism, patience, and respectful communication with potential clients and heirs.

- Accurate recordkeeping and the ability to follow company procedures.

- Willingness to protect confidential client and company information.



**Calling System and Monitoring**



We expect to use Grasshopper for business calls. The final calling platform will be confirmed during training. Calls will be recorded and monitored by the owner for training, quality, and performance review.



**Company-Wide Bonus Opportunities**



All employees may receive company-wide bonuses after contracts successfully pay out and the company earns revenue from those contracts. The owner will determine bonus amounts, recipients, and payout timing. Bonuses are discretionary, not guaranteed, and separate from hourly pay.



**How to Apply**



**Send a WhatsApp message to +1 (303)
expressing your interest in this position.**



Include:



- Your name and a brief introduction.

- Your previous cold calling experience.

- Your understanding of the surplus funds recovery business.

- Confirmation that you have your own computer, internet connection, and headset.

- Confirmation that you accept the pay and can work the listed U.S. schedule.

description:
Please just send us any message if you're interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form.

Why strong setters join us

We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. If you're experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.

01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there's no ceiling on what you can earn each month.

02 — Experienced leadership that develops you



You'll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what's working, coach on what isn't, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.

03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You'll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.



Compensation — paid every week via Wise

Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed



Per qualified appointment (showed up): $50 USD — every one, on top of the base



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)



That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).

This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that's you, and you're comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.

To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we'll be coaching you throughout to help you get there.



What you'll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.

Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote.

Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.

Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.

Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.





Who we're looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.





What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out.

title: Digital Marketing & Executive Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
# Digital Marketing & Executive Operations Virtual Assistant



**SEO | AI Search Optimization | Website Management | Social Media | Real Estate Operations**



**Job Type:** Full-Time, Remote  

**Schedule:** 40 Hours Weekly | Night Shift / Graveyard Shift  

**Work Allocation:** Two Businesses | Dedicated Hours for Each  

**Communication:** Fluent Spoken and Written English Required  

**Reporting:** Mandatory Weekly Reports and Google Meet Meetings



## Position Overview



We are seeking a highly skilled, versatile, and results-driven Virtual Assistant to provide digital marketing, technical, creative, and administrative support for two growing businesses.



This unique position combines SEO, AI search optimization, website management, social media content creation, real estate transaction coordination, lead generation, and executive administrative support.



The selected candidate will divide their working hours between two business owners, managing assigned responsibilities for each business while maintaining clear communication, organization, and accountability.



We are looking for a long-term team member who is technically proficient, creative, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities without constant supervision.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. SEO & AI Search Optimization

- Develop and implement strategies to improve website visibility and organic search rankings.

- Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and SEO audits.

- Optimize website content, metadata, internal links, and technical SEO elements.

- Implement Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) strategies.

- Improve website content for visibility across Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search platforms.

- Monitor keyword rankings, website traffic, search performance, and AI search visibility.

- Identify opportunities to improve lead generation and online conversions.

- Provide measurable performance updates and recommendations.



### 2. Website Development & Management

- Build, update, maintain, and optimize business websites.

- Create landing pages and implement website improvements.

- Ensure websites are mobile-friendly, responsive, and optimized for speed.

- Troubleshoot website errors and technical issues.

- Manage website integrations, plugins, updates, and basic security.

- Implement SEO recommendations and improve website user experience.

- Maintain consistent branding and professional presentation.



### 3. Social Media Management & Video Editing



Manage content for multiple platforms, including real estate and Christian marriage content.



- Edit raw video footage using **CapCut**.

- Create engaging Instagram Reels,
 videos, TikToks, and short-form content.

- Add captions, transitions, music, graphics, and other visual elements.

- Prepare polished video drafts for the business owner to add personal voiceovers.

- Design graphics and promotional materials using Canva or similar tools.

- Write engaging captions and assist with content scheduling.

- Maintain separate branding, messaging, and creative styles for each platform.

- Monitor social media engagement and identify opportunities for growth.

- Organize content libraries and maintain consistent posting schedules.



### 4. Real Estate Transaction Coordination

- Provide administrative support from contract execution through closing.

- Monitor contract deadlines, inspections, appraisals, financing milestones, and closing dates.

- Coordinate routine communication with lenders, title companies, inspectors, and clients.

- Track outstanding documents and required paperwork.

- Maintain organized transaction files and checklists.

- Schedule inspections, closing appointments, and client meetings.

- Provide transaction status updates.

- Escalate contract interpretation, negotiations, and licensed real estate activities to the supervising agent.



### 5. Cold Calling, Lead Generation & CRM Management

- Conduct outbound calls to prospective customers and real estate leads.

- Follow up with existing clients and new inquiries.

- Schedule consultations, appointments, and follow-up calls.

- Manage client databases and update CRM records.

- Organize leads by status, priority, and stage in the sales process.

- Create follow-up reminders and automated workflows.

- Track client communication and lead conversion activity.

- Maintain professional communication and use approved scripts in compliance with applicable regulations.



### 6. Executive Administrative Support

- Manage calendars, appointments, and daily schedules.

- Organize
s, documents, and business information.

- Maintain task lists and project trackers.

- Coordinate meetings and follow-up activities.

- Assist with ongoing marketing and operational projects.

- Identify opportunities to improve workflow efficiency.

- Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling business and client information.



## Weekly Reporting & Accountability



**Weekly written performance reports are mandatory for both businesses.**



Reports should be organized separately and include:



**Digital Marketing & Website Performance**

- SEO tasks completed and keyword ranking changes.

- Website traffic and performance metrics.

- AI search optimization progress.

- Website updates and technical issues resolved.

- Social media content created and published.

- Engagement and audience growth metrics.



**Real Estate & Administrative Performance**

- Number of outbound calls and client contacts.

- Follow-ups completed and appointments scheduled.

- CRM updates and lead pipeline activity.

- Transaction coordination updates.

- Outstanding tasks and upcoming deadlines.



**Both Reports Must Include**

- Total hours worked and time allocated to each business.

- Completed tasks and measurable results.

- Challenges or outstanding issues.

- Priorities and action plans for the following week.



The candidate must attend scheduled Google Meet meetings with the business owners to review performance, discuss priorities, and receive feedback.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous experience as a Virtual Assistant, Digital Marketing Specialist, or similar position.

- Strong knowledge of SEO and website optimization.

- Familiarity with AI Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO).

- Experience with website development and management.

- **Proficiency in CapCut video editing is mandatory.**

- **Proficiency in CRM software is mandatory.**

- Experience with Canva and social media management.

- Strong cold-calling and client communication skills.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Ability to work during designated graveyard shift hours.

- Comfortable attending live Google Meet meetings.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.

- Reliable internet connection and a professional remote work environment.

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and communicate proactively.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience supporting U.S.-based businesses.

- Familiarity with real estate transactions and administrative processes.

- Experience with WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, or similar website platforms.

- Knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Ahrefs.

- Experience with CRM automation and lead management.

- Experience creating engaging short-form video content.

- Familiarity with Google Workspace and project management tools.

- Experience managing responsibilities for multiple businesses or clients.



## Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is:



- **Technically Skilled:** Comfortable working with websites, SEO tools, CRM systems, and digital platforms.

- **Creative:** Capable of producing engaging content for different audiences.

- **Organized:** Able to track multiple projects, deadlines, and responsibilities.

- **Proactive:** Identifies problems and opportunities without waiting for instructions.

- **Communicative:** Confident speaking English during calls and meetings.

- **Accountable:** Provides consistent updates, accurate reports, and measurable results.

- **Adaptable:** Can transition between technical, creative, and administrative responsibilities.

- **Dependable:** Maintains consistent attendance, productivity, and professionalism.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. An updated resume detailing your relevant experience.

2. Examples of websites you have developed or optimized.

3. Examples of SEO results or AI search optimization projects.

4. A portfolio of videos edited using CapCut.

5. A list of CRM platforms and digital marketing tools you have used.

6. Details of your experience with cold calling, administrative support, or real estate.

7. Confirmation of your availability for graveyard shifts.

8. Your expected hourly rate or monthly compensation.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a practical skills assessment covering video editing, SEO analysis, CRM organization, and professional English communication.



**We are seeking a long-term professional who can become a valuable part of both businesses, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and contribute to continued growth through strong communication, creativity, technical expertise, and consistent execution.**

title: Sales Closer – Auto Repair Shop Software (Final Selection Stage, Apply Now)
description:
Outbound Sales Closer – Auto Repair Shop Software (US Market)



We are in the final stages of selecting our closer. If you have personally closed sales and this role fits you, apply now. We plan to make a decision soon, and complete applications that arrive in the next few days will be reviewed right away.



About us



We are an authorized reseller of Mitchell 1 software for independent auto repair shops in the United States. Mitchell 1 is used by thousands of US shops for repair information (ProDemand), shop management and estimating (Manager SE), and customer follow-up and marketing (SocialCRM). We help shop owners choose the right products, get set up and get value from them.



The first product you will sell is ProDemand, repair information software that gives technicians OEM repair procedures, wiring diagrams, maintenance schedules and labor times in one search, plus real-world fixes from other technicians.

Product overview: 

Short demo videos: 



The role



You will call independent auto repair shops in the US, book and run product demos, and close sales. You will also receive warm leads from our team to close. After the sale you will help new customers get started, train their service writers and technicians on the basics, and handle first-line software questions. You will work closely with a small team, share what is working, and keep our CRM up to date.



Demos are a big part of this job. You will learn our products quickly from Mitchell 1's sales materials and product videos, then turn them into short, crisp pitches and screen-share demos built around what a shop owner cares about: saving time, making money and getting cars out the door.



This is a closing role. You must have personally closed sales and earned commission on the deals you closed. Appointment setting, lead generation or customer service experience alone does not qualify. Applications without closing experience will be declined.



What you will do



- Make outbound calls to US auto repair shop owners and managers.

- Qualify each shop and book demos.

- Follow up on warm leads from our team and close them.

- Review Mitchell 1 sales materials, product videos and updates, and turn them into short, crisp pitches and demo scripts for shop owners.

- Run screen-share demos built around a shop's day: looking up a repair, writing an estimate, following up with the customer.

- Handle objections and ask for the sale.

- Onboard new customers and train their staff on first steps.

- Answer first-line support questions (logins, setup, "where do I find…") and escalate to Mitchell 1 support when needed.

- Log every call and deal in the CRM.



What we are looking for



Required



- At least 1 year of closing sales yourself, with numbers you can back up: deals closed, deal sizes and close rate. Proof is required before an interview, such as a commission statement, CRM screenshot or a reference from a sales manager.

- Experience running live product demos (screen share or in person), and reviewing sales materials to build your own short, clear pitch.

- Comfortable recording audio with Vocaroo and screen-share video with Loom (both free) to share pitches and demos with our team.

- Experience cold calling US businesses, with daily call volumes you can describe.

- Clear, confident spoken English suited to busy US small-business owners.

- A quiet work space with minimal background noise and a noise-cancelling headset.

- Availability for a set schedule within US Pacific business hours.



Nice to have



- Software or subscription (SaaS) sales experience.

- Automotive, parts or repair shop experience.

- Technical support or customer training experience.

- Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

- Spanish.

- Reliable internet and electricity, with a backup internet connection on a different network and backup power (UPS, generator or power station).



Our hiring process



We are in the final stages of selection, so please apply as soon as you can.



1. Apply with the items listed below.

2. Short follow-up questions and a voice recording (a few minutes of your time).



How to apply



Please include all of the following. Applications missing these items will not be reviewed.



1. Start your application with the words "Repair Shop Closer" so we know you read this post.

I am seeking a highly organized, proactive, and creative Virtual Assistant to support my growing real estate business and manage content for two separate social media platforms.



This position combines real estate transaction coordination, cold calling, client follow-up, CRM management, video editing, social media management, and general administrative support.

s, documents, and business records.

At ClickCallSell, we're looking for a full-time Video Editor who loves creating engaging short-form content for our internal brand and our home-service marketing clients across the United States.



This position is more than cutting clips and adding captions. We're looking for someone who enjoys storytelling, understands pacing and viewer retention, has a great sense of humor, and takes pride in creating videos that perform.



If you're someone who naturally thinks, "This could be even better..." and enjoys making creative improvements, we'd love to meet you.

Short-form social media videos

Client advertisements

Testimonials

Educational content

Promotional videos

Brand content



Our videos are created for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts.

Stay organized and manage projects through 
.

We're looking for someone who understands what American audiences find funny, relatable, surprising, or worth sharing, not someone who simply follows editing trends without considering the audience.



The Person We're Looking For

Technical editing skills are important, but they're only part of what makes someone successful here.



We're looking for someone who is:

Creative and confident with their ideas

Takes ownership of the final product

Comfortable making decisions independently

Proactive and solution-oriented

Curious and always looking for ways to improve

Coachable and open to direct feedback

Organized, dependable, and consistent

Focused on creating content that performs, not just content that looks polished



We'll always provide footage, scripts, concepts, brand guidelines, and creative direction, but we also value editors who can bring their own ideas to the table.

Motion graphics, sound design, caption animation, and color correction experience

Experience creating content for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts

The ability to source relevant B-roll, graphics, memes, music, and sound effects

Strong English comprehension and communication skills

A positive attitude toward feedback and revisions

This is a long-term opportunity with a team that genuinely enjoys working together.

How to Apply

Please begin your application with the words:

I CREATE VIRAL CONTENT.

Then include the following:

Your three strongest short-form videos, ranked Good, Better, and Best

Three American creators, brands, or comedy accounts you regularly follow and admire

If you enjoy creating videos that people genuinely want to watch and you're excited to be part of a collaborative, creative, and growing team, we'd love to hear from you.



Cheers,

The ClickCallSell Team

title: Client Success & Manager (High-Ticket Coaching)
description:
About PHNYX Group

PHNYX Group is a venture studio with operations in Dubai, Switzerland and China. We partner with founders to build, grow and sell physical product brands.



Our founder has built multiple brands, including PHNYX Watches, which has done millions in revenue. We also run high-ticket coaching programs and a mastermind that teach people how to build and grow ecommerce brands.



Why this role exists

Leads and clients are our most valuable relationships. Right now, follow-up depends on too many people remembering to do it.

We want one person who makes sure every lead is followed up, every client feels looked after, and every concern reaches our founder fast.



What you will own

Making sure every new lead is contacted within 5 minutes

Reading sales call notes in Fathom and keeping GHL up to date: who bought, who didn't, and why

Steady, helpful follow-up with everyone who hasn't bought yet

A weekly report on the main reasons people don't buy

Fast, smooth onboarding for new clients

Detailed client profiles: what they do, why they joined, where they live

Checking in with clients so they stay happy and keep growing with us

Flagging any client concern to our founder within 24 hours

Setting up follow-up automations in GHL and Zapier, or working with the person who does



What success looks like

No lead waits more than 5 minutes

60-70% of past clients buy again

Refunds at 1% or less, and fewer than 5% of clients cancel or quit in a year

Our founder always knows why people aren't buying

Clients feel genuinely cared for



Who we are looking for

Someone who genuinely cares about clients. You follow up because you want them to win, not just to close a sale.

You notice when a client goes quiet and reach out before they think about quitting. You hear the real reason behind "I need to think about it."

You are organized. No lead, note or promise ever falls through the cracks.



Experience required

You have worked in client success, sales operations or follow-up for a high-ticket coaching, education or consulting business

You have followed up with leads after sales calls and helped close them

You have onboarded and looked after high-ticket clients

You use GHL or a similar CRM every day

Big plus: offers priced $5,000+, mastermind experience, and building automations yourself



Technology you should know

GHL and Zapier

Fathom or a similar note-taker

DocuSign


, Loom, Google Workspace

ChatGPT and Claude



How we work

Full time and fully remote

5 days a week, split shift: 5 hours in Dubai working hours and 4 hours in US Eastern hours

Finish your week's tasks and Saturday is off. Our weekly team meeting is on Fridays.

You report to our Chief of Staff

You send a short Loom update every day

Reply times: under 2 hours is our standard, 24 hours is the absolute maximum



Compensation

$1,000-$1,200/month, depending on experience

Paid via PayPal or card payment (not bank transfer). Salary is paid at the end of each month for the first 4 months, then twice a month, on the 15th and the last day of the month

$2,000 quarterly bonus when refunds stay under 1%



2-week paid probation

You start with 2 paid weeks doing real work with our leads and clients. This is how we see what you can do, and how you see if you want to work with us.



If it goes well, you move to a month-to-month contract.



How to apply

Apply on OnlineJobs.ph with:

1. The subject line: "Client Success - [Your Name]" (we use this to check attention to detail)

2. The coaching or education businesses you've worked for, and your role

3. Proof of results: follow-up close rates, retention or refund numbers

4. A Loom video, 3 minutes max, introducing yourself and explaining how you follow up with a lead who said "I need to think about it"

5. Your answers to these application questions. Each question asks for specifics that are hard to fake. Vague answers score low:

>> Which coaching or education business did you work for? What were the offer prices, and what did YOU personally own?

>> What % of leads who didn't buy on the first call did you help close later? How did you track it?

>> A lead says "I need to talk to my spouse." Write the follow-up message you'd send the next day.

>> What are the 3 most common reasons people don't buy a high-ticket program? How do you handle each one?

>> Tell us about a client who wanted a refund. What did you do, and what happened?

>> How do you spot a client who is about to quit, before they say it?

>> What have you built in GHL or Zapier yourself? Be specific.

>> How do you make sure every lead is contacted within 5 minutes, even at night?

>> A lead asks for a 20% discount. Our limit is 7%. What do you say?

>> How do you turn a pile of sales call notes into something useful for the founder?

>> Describe a time you noticed a problem no one asked you to look at. What did you do?

>> Can you work 5 hours in Dubai working hours and 4 hours in US Eastern hours, 5 days a week? Yes or no.

title: Amazon Wholesale Product Research Specialist (full time Remote)
description:

This role is wholesale only. If your background is mainly online arbitrage or retail arbitrage, this will not be a good fit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Work through supplier price lists (CSV, Excel, PDF) from US distributors and brands and match items to Amazon listings using:

  * UPC scans

  * Manual title searches, including multipack and bundle listings

  * Reverse sourcing from competitor storefronts and brand catalogs

  * Profitability after FBA fees

  * Sales rank and historical sales velocity

  * Price history and seasonality

  * Number of competitive FBA sellers and buy box behavior

  * Amazon is on the listing

title: Video Editor - A Players ONLY
description:
Video Editor: Luxury and Aviation YouTube Channel



World Of Luxury is a YouTube channel covering private jets, helicopters and the way billionaires travel. Our videos run 9 to 11 minutes and live or die on two things: footage that looks like a million dollars, and editing that keeps people watching to the end.



We're looking for an editor who can take a finished script and voiceover, source the right footage the right way, and turn it into a video that feels premium, moves fast and stays on the right side of YouTube's rules. If you know the difference between a Global 7500 and a G700 by looking at the cabin, even better.



This is a long-term role. Do it well and the volume grows.



What you'll do

You get a script and a recorded voiceover. You hand back a finished, upload-ready 4K video, a clip log, and three thumbnail frame suggestions. Everything in between is yours.



For every video

1. Read the script and plan the edit. Break it into segments, note every aircraft, owner and number mentioned, and list the shots you need.

2. Source the footage. Pull from manufacturer media libraries, broker and press-office footage, and our licensed stock libraries. Request original files and written permission from press offices and brokers where needed. No ripping other channels' videos.

3. Verify every aircraft. Make sure the footage shows the exact model and variant the voiceover names. Check tail numbers on public registries where ownership is claimed. Flag anything that doesn't add up to the scriptwriter.

4. Build the edit. Cut to the voiceover, structure the video to our 10-minute blueprint, and keep a visual change every 3 to 5 seconds. Hook in the first 5 seconds, re-hooks every 60 to 90 seconds, best asset last.

5. Add original graphics. Lower thirds with specs and prices, spec comparison cards, range maps. At least one original graphic per video.

6. Grade and finish. Match colour across mixed sources and apply the channel look. Clean the voiceover, lay licensed music and subtle sound design, and mix to around −14 LUFS.

7. Log every clip. Timecode, source, licence or permission, and proof file for every third-party shot.

8. Run the QC checklist and deliver through our shared drive.

Standards you'll work to

You'll get our full editing SOP on day one. The non-negotiables:

• Mute all source audio, always.

• Keep any one third-party shot under 6 seconds and any one source under 10% of the runtime.

• No watermarks, no stretched footage, nothing under 1080p.

• No tricks to dodge Content ID (flipping, mirroring, speed changes). We do it properly instead.

• No AI-generated footage passed off as real aircraft, people or places.

• Every video must feel different. No duplicating last week's project and swapping the names.



Week to week

• Deliver 3 videos per week

• Take one round of revisions per video, turned around within 24–48 hours.

• Keep a growing library of cleared footage, organised by manufacturer and model, so each video gets faster.

• Look at retention graphs with the channel manager and apply what they show to the next edit.

• Pass every copyright claim straight to the channel manager. You never dispute claims yourself.



What you need

• 2+ years editing long-form YouTube content (8 minutes plus). Show us videos with real retention, not just showreels.

• Strong in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, and After Effects (or equivalent) for lower thirds and simple motion graphics.

• A good eye for colour matching footage from many different cameras and sources.

• Solid audio skills: cleaning voiceover, mixing music under dialogue, subtle sound design.

• A working understanding of YouTube copyright: Content ID claims vs strikes, licensed vs unlicensed footage, and why the reused content policy matters for compilation-style channels.

• Reliable on deadlines and good at clear, written updates.

• A fast connection and a machine that handles 4K timelines.



Nice to have

• Knowledge of business aviation, superyachts or luxury cars.

• Experience on faceless or documentary-style channels.

• Experience contacting press offices or brands to request footage.

• Basic thumbnail design skills.



What we offer

• Pay: rate per video $35

• Steady, long-term work with clear briefs: script and voiceover are ready before you start

• A full SOP, licensed stock and music libraries paid for by us

• More volume and higher rates for editors who hit the standard consistently



How to apply

Send the following 

1. Links to 2 or 3 long-form YouTube videos you edited, and what you did on each.

2. One sentence on how you'd source footage of a specific jet interior without breaking YouTube's rules.

3. Your rate and weekly capacity.

4. Start your message with the word "Gulfstream" so we know you read the whole advert.

Shortlisted editors get a paid to do test video

title: Hiring & Recruitment Coordinator
description:
Remote Virtual Assistant – Hiring & Recruitment Coordinator



Company: 24H Print & Embroidery  

Location: Remote  

Job Type: Part-Time or Full-Time  

Schedule: Flexible, with availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours  

Compensation: Based on experience



About Us



24H Print & Embroidery is a growing U.S.-based manufacturing company located in Fredericksburg, Virginia. We specialize in embroidery and apparel production, with a focus on efficiency, quality, and scalable manufacturing operations.



As our manufacturing team continues to grow, we are looking for a highly organized, confident, and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to manage our employee recruitment and interview process.



About the Role



Your primary responsibility will be to manage our hiring process for in-person manufacturing employees.



We will provide a structured hiring system, including instructions, interview questions, evaluation criteria, and procedures for moving candidates through each stage.



Your job will be to follow this system consistently, professionally interview applicants, evaluate their qualifications, and identify the strongest candidates for our manufacturing team.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the recruitment process and work independently with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities



1. Applicant Screening

- Review incoming job applications and resumes.

- Evaluate applicants against our hiring requirements.

- Identify qualified applicants and reject those who do not meet our criteria.

- Contact candidates to confirm interest and availability.

- Maintain accurate records of all applicants.



2. Interview Scheduling & Communication

- Contact applicants through
, phone, or messaging.

- Schedule and coordinate virtual interviews.

- Send interview confirmations and reminders.

- Follow up with candidates who do not respond or miss interviews.

- Maintain professional and timely communication throughout the hiring process.



3. Conducting Interviews

- Independently conduct virtual interviews with prospective manufacturing employees.

- Follow our provided interview scripts and structured interview process.

- Ask follow-up questions when appropriate.

- Evaluate candidates' communication, reliability, attitude, experience, and ability to follow instructions.

- Identify potential concerns or red flags.

- Record detailed interview notes and candidate evaluations.



4. Candidate Evaluation & Selection

- Score candidates using our established evaluation system.

- Compare applicants based on objective hiring criteria.

- Recommend the strongest candidates for the next stage.

- Provide concise summaries explaining why each candidate should or should not advance.

- Coordinate additional interviews, skills assessments, or in-person evaluations when required.



5. Hiring Process Management

- Track applicants through each stage of the hiring pipeline.

- Ensure every candidate completes the required steps.

- Maintain organized recruitment spreadsheets or hiring software.

- Follow up on incomplete applications, assessments, or documentation.

- Provide regular reports on hiring progress, applicant quality, and interview outcomes.



6. Process Improvement

- Identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies in the recruitment process.

- Suggest improvements to screening and interviewing procedures.

- Help maintain and update hiring documentation.

- Ensure the hiring process remains organized and consistent as the company grows.



Requirements



- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Strong communication skills and confidence conducting video interviews.

- Previous experience in recruitment, interviewing, HR, or virtual assistance preferred.

- Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.

- Comfortable following detailed standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Strong independent decision-making abilities.

- Ability to evaluate people objectively and professionally.

- Reliable internet connection, computer, camera, and microphone.

- Experience using Google Sheets, Google Docs, scheduling software, and video meeting platforms.

- Ability to maintain confidentiality of applicant information.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is:



- Confident: Comfortable leading interviews and asking difficult questions.

- Detail-Oriented: Follows hiring processes precisely without skipping steps.

- Independent: Can manage the recruitment process without constant supervision.

- Organized: Keeps track of multiple applicants and hiring stages simultaneously.

- Observant: Can recognize strong candidates and identify potential concerns.

- Proactive: Follows up with applicants and keeps the hiring process moving.

- Professional: Represents our company positively throughout every interaction.



What Success Looks Like



A successful Hiring & Recruitment Coordinator will:



- Consistently identify qualified manufacturing applicants.

- Conduct thorough, structured interviews.

- Keep our hiring pipeline organized and updated.

- Minimize the amount of time management spends screening applicants.

- Ensure candidates are evaluated fairly and consistently.

- Deliver a shortlist of qualified candidates ready for final approval or in-person assessment.

- Help us build a reliable, productive manufacturing team.



Training & Support



We will provide a complete hiring process, including screening requirements, interview scripts, candidate evaluation forms, and step-by-step procedures.



You will receive training on our manufacturing operation, employee expectations, and the qualities we look for in successful team members.



Your responsibility will be to learn this system and execute it consistently.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a short introduction explaining your experience conducting interviews, recruiting employees, or managing hiring processes.



We are especially interested in candidates who have previously conducted interviews independently and are comfortable evaluating applicants using structured scoring systems.

title: Project Manager – Creative Studio / Production Company
description:

Are you the person who keeps every deadline, meeting, and moving part under control?



At mondays, we’re looking for an exceptionally organized Project Manager to own our company calendar, coordinate projects, and keep communication clear across our team and clients.



You’ll turn priorities into realistic schedules, make room for new projects, and keep work moving from planning through shoots, post-production, and final delivery. We need someone proactive, precise, and dependable—someone who follows through without needing reminders.

Building realistic schedules: Break projects into clear tasks, owners, and deadlines, accounting for team availability, dependencies, and production requirements.



Scheduling new projects: Find workable ways to accommodate incoming work, identify conflicts early, and communicate the adjustments needed.



Following up consistently: Stay on top of outstanding tasks, feedback, approvals, and deliverables so nothing falls through the cracks.



Maintaining excellent client communication: Send clear updates, coordinate meetings, manage expectations, and communicate schedule changes promptly and professionally.



Coordinating production and post-production: Keep handoffs, edits, revisions, approvals, and final deliveries aligned with the overall schedule.



Improving how we work: Build practical systems and processes that make our projects easier to track and our schedules more reliable.



Using AI in daily operations: Use tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to turn briefs into project plans, organize information, extract action items, document processes, and streamline recurring work.



We’re looking for someone with:



Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.



Previous project management or production coordination experience in entertainment, shoots, and post-production.



A strong understanding of production workflows, revision cycles, approvals, and delivery deadlines.



Excellent written and spoken English, with polished, professional communication and confidence working directly with clients.



The ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize competing deadlines, and adapt schedules when plans change.



Confidence using shared calendars and project management software.



Strong practical proficiency with AI tools. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, or similar software in real workflows, know how to give clear instructions, and check outputs before putting them into use.



The ability to work independently and take ownership in a remote environment.



Korean, Mandarin, or Spanish proficiency is a huge plus.



To apply, please include:



Your CV and a brief introduction explaining why you’re a strong fit.



An example of how you managed overlapping projects, production schedules, or competing deadlines.



The calendar and project management tools you use.



One specific example of how you use AI to improve your day-to-day work.



Your availability, time zone, and languages spoken.



We’d love to hear how you would help keep mondays organized, on schedule, and communicating clearly.

title: UGC editor
description:
Title: Short-Form Video Editor – UGC Ads for Fitness & App Brands (TikTok/Reels)



About me

I’m a UGC creator making short-form video ads for fitness and app brands. I film, and I need a fast, reliable editor to turn my raw footage into ready-to-submit videos so I can focus on filming and landing brands.



What you’ll do



Edit vertical (9:16) videos, 15–45 seconds

Combine one main video with several different hooks, exporting a separate version for each hook (e.g. 1 body + 5 hooks = 5 videos)

Cut all dead air and pauses so the video moves fast

Add clean, readable captions on every video

Add app screen recordings, B-roll, and simple text overlays where needed

Follow a written editing guide and each brand’s rules

Export in 1080p or higher with no watermarks, name files correctly, and upload to a shared Google Drive



How it works

Everything lives in one organized Google Drive: raw footage sorted by brand, scripts and briefs, assets, and a step-by-step editor guide. I upload, you edit, I review and submit. Simple and clear.



Volume: around [5–15] videos per day,

Turnaround: footage uploaded the next day

Pay: $3 per video, with more work as volume grows



You must have



Experience editing TikTok, Reels, or UGC-style ads (send examples)

CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar

A strong sense of pacing: fast cuts, strong first second

Good English for captions and following instructions

Reliable internet and on-time delivery

Discretion: all brand content stays confidential



Nice to have



Experience with paid ads (Meta or TikTok)

An eye for scroll-stopping hooks and overlays



How to apply



Start your message with “UGC EDITOR” (so I know you read this)

Send 2–3 short-form videos you’ve edited

Tell me which software you use and your availability (time zone + hours)



Shortlisted applicants will get a paid test edit using real footage.
